'''Telegram''' (also known as '''Telegram Messenger''') is a Russian-Emirati [[Cloud computing|cloud-based]], [[Cross-platform software|cross-platform]] [[social media]] and [[instant messaging]] (IM) service. It launched for iOS on 14 August 2013 and Android on 20 October 2013. It allows users to exchange messages, share media and files, and hold private and group voice or [[Videotelephony|video calls]] as well as public [[Live streaming|livestreams]]. It is available for [[Android (operating system)|Android]], [[iOS]], [[Microsoft Windows|Windows]], [[macOS]], [[Linux]], [[Wear OS]], [[watchOS]] and [[web browser]]s. Telegram offers [[end-to-end encryption]] in voice and video calls,<ref>{{cite web |date=14 August 2020 |title=Telegram introduces end-to-end encrypted video calls |url=https://thenextweb.com/apps/2020/08/14/telegram-introduces-end-to-end-encrypted-video-calls/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210301150437/https://thenextweb.com/apps/2020/08/14/telegram-introduces-end-to-end-encrypted-video-calls/ |archive-date=1 March 2021 |access-date=29 March 2021 |website=The Next Web}}</ref> and optionally in private chats if both participants use a [[mobile device]].

Telegram also has social networking features, allowing users to post [[Story (social media)|stories]], create public groups with up to 200,000 members, and share one-way updates to unlimited audiences in so-called channels.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Peters |first=Jay |date=16 February 2023 |title=Meta is copying Telegram channels in Instagram |url=https://www.theverge.com/2023/2/16/23602833/meta-instagram-channels-telegram-facebook-messenger |access-date=17 October 2023 |website=The Verge |language=en}}</ref>

Telegram was founded in 2013 by [[Pavel Durov|Pavel]] and [[Nikolai Durov]].<ref>{{Cite news |author=EWDN |date=30 August 2013 |title=Russia's Zuckerberg launches Telegram, a new instant messenger service |language=en |work=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/idUS74722569420130830 |url-status=live |access-date=8 November 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210128165349/https://www.reuters.com/article/idUS74722569420130830 |archive-date=28 January 2021}}</ref><ref name="TechCrunch">{{cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2013/10/27/meet-telegram-a-secure-messaging-app-from-the-founders-of-vk-russias-largest-social-network/|title=Meet Telegram, A Secure Messaging App From The Founders Of VK, Russia's Largest Social Network|last=Shu|first=Catherine|date=27 October 2013|website=TechCrunch|access-date=18 March 2016|archive-date=26 November == History ==

=== Development ===
Telegram was launched in 2013 by the brothers [[Nikolai Durov|Nikolai]] and [[Pavel Durov]]. Previously, the pair founded the Russian social network [[VK (social network)|VK]], which they left in 2014, saying it had been taken over by the government.<ref name=DurovTI22414>{{cite news |url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2014-04-22/news/49318882_1_social-network-vkontakte-pavel-durov-founder-mark-zuckerberg |title=Pavel Durov left Russia after being pushed out |date=22 April 2014 |access-date=23 April 2014 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140424024304/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2014-04-22/news/49318882_1_social-network-vkontakte-pavel-durov-founder-mark-zuckerberg |archive-date=24 April 2014 |publisher=[[Agence France-Presse]] |via=Economic Times }}</ref> Pavel sold his remaining stake in VK and left Russia after resisting government pressure.<ref name="NYTDurov" /> Nikolai created the MTProto protocol that is the basis for the messenger, while Pavel provided financial support and infrastructure through his [[Axel Neff#Digital Fortress LLC|Digital Fortress]] fund.<ref name="TechCrunch" /> Telegram Messenger denies that its end goal is to profit,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-are-you-going-to-make-money-out-of-this |title=Telegram F.A.Q |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140209082001/https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-are-you-going-to-make-money-out-of-this |archive-date=9 February 2014 |quote=...making profits will never be an end-goal for Telegram.}}</ref><ref name="Verge2014">{{cite news |last=Hamburger |first=Ellis |date=25 February 2014 |title=Why Telegram has become the hottest messaging app in the world |url=https://www.theverge.com/2014/2/25/5445864/telegram-messenger-hottest-app-in-the-world |work=The Verge |access-date=25 February 2014 |quote=Telegram operates as a non-profit organization, and doesn’t plan to charge for its services. |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160313050911/http://www.theverge.com/2014/2/25/5445864/telegram-messenger-hottest-app-in-the-world |archive-date=13 March 2016 |url-status=live}}</ref> but it is not structured as a nonprofit organization.<ref name="WaPo1">{{cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/the-intersect/wp/2015/11/23/the-secret-american-origins-of-telegram-the-encrypted-messaging-app-favored-by-the-islamic-state/|title=The secret American origins of Telegram, the encrypted messaging app favored by the Islamic State|last1=Dewey|first1=Caitlin|date=23 November 2015|access-date=31 March 2018|newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]|archive-date=12 May Telegram is registered as a company in the [[British Virgin Islands]]<ref name="Telegram Messenger Inc – RIPE NCC"/> and as an [[Limited company|LLC]] in Dubai.<ref>{{cite web|title = Telegram Messenger on the App Store|url = https://apps.apple.com/app/telegram-messenger/id686449807|website = App Store|access-date = 19 November 2015|archive-date = 19 May 2019|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190519201602/https://itunes.apple.com/app/telegram-messenger/id686449807|url-status = live}}</ref><ref>[https://www.dnb.com/business-directory/company-profiles.telegram_fz_llc.adcbb6d4f706fd666c04a7b5c9178b02.html Telegram FZ LLC – Dun & Bradstreet]</ref> It does not disclose where it rents offices or which legal entities it uses to rent them, citing the need to "shelter the team from unnecessary influence" and protect users from governmental data requests.<ref>{{Cite news|title = Lunch with the FT: Pavel Durov|url = https://www.ft.com/content/21c5c7f2-20b1-11e5-ab0f-6bb9974f25d0|newspaper = [[Financial Times]]|access-date = 19 November 2015|first = John|last = Thornhill|date = After Pavel Durov left Russia in 2014, he was said to be moving from country to country with a small group of computer programmers consisting of 15 core members.<ref name="NYTDurov">{{Cite news|title = Once Celebrated in Russia, the Programmer Pavel Durov Chooses Exile|url = https://www.nytimes.com/2014/12/03/technology/once-celebrated-in-russia-programmer-pavel-durov-chooses-exile.html|newspaper news|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-telecoms-mobileworld-telegram-idUSKCN0VW2CM|title=Telegram app free-speech advocate no stranger to Apple-FBI woes|newspaper=Reuters|date=23 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512140540/https://www.reuters.com/article/us-telecoms-mobileworld-telegram-idUSKCN0VW2CM|url-status=live|last1=Auchard|first1=Eric}}</ref>

While a former employee of VK said that Telegram had employees in [[Saint Petersburg]], Pavel said the Telegram team made [[Berlin]], Germany, its headquarters in 2014, but failed to obtain German residence permits for everyone on the team and moved to other jurisdictions in early 2015.<ref name="Turton-2017-09-29">{{cite web|last1=Turton|first1=William|title=What isn't Telegram saying about its connections to the Kremlin?|url=https://theoutline.com/post/2348/what-isn-t-telegram-saying-about-its-connections-to-the-kremlin|website=The Outline|access-date=11 October 2017|date=29 September 2017|archive-date=18 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190518221134/https://theoutline.com/post/2348/what-isn-t-telegram-saying-about-its-connections-to-the-kremlin|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="TheVergeKorea">{{cite web |last=Brandom |first=Russell |date=6 October 2014 |title=Surveillance drives South Koreans to encrypted messaging apps |url=https://www.theverge.com/2014/10/6/6926205/surveillance-drives-south-koreans-to-encrypted-messaging-apps |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151106162327/http://www.theverge.com/2014/10/6/6926205/surveillance-drives-south-koreans-to-encrypted-messaging-apps |archive-date=6 November 2015 |access-date=19 November 2015 |website=[[The Verge]]}}</ref> Since 2017, the company has been based in Dubai.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Descalsota |first1=Marielle |title=Meet Pavel Durov, the tech billionaire who founded Telegram, fled from Moscow 15 years ago after defying the Kremlin, and has a penchant for posting half-naked selfies on Instagram |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/pavel-durov-telegram-billionaire-russia-instagram-wealth-founder-dubai-lifestyle-2022-3 |access-date=1 May 2022 |work=Business Insider |date=28 March 2022}}</ref> Its data centers are spread across a complex [[corporate structure]] of [[Shell corporation|shell companies]] in various jurisdictions to avoid compliance with government [[subpoena]]s.<ref name="NYTDurov" /><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=Newton |first=Casey |date=26 August 2024 |title=How Telegram played itself |url=https://www.platformer.news/telegram-durov-arrest-france-explainer/ |access-date=28 August 2024 |website=Platformer |language=en}}</ref> The company says this is done "to protect the data that is not covered by end-to-end encryption". Telegram's FAQ page says it does not process requests related to illegal content in chats and group chats, and that "to this day, we have disclosed 0 bytes of user messages to third parties, including governments".<ref name=":5" /> But according to Pavel, Telegram disclosed data for 203 legal requests from the Brazilian government in January to September 2024 and 6,992 legal requests from India, its largest market, during that period.<ref name=":7">{{Cite web |title=Du Rove's Channel |url=https://t.me/durov/346 |access-date=5 October 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref> Users can use Telegram's transparency bot to check how many legal requests from their country it has processed.<ref name=":7" />

=== Usage ===
In October 2013, Telegram announced that it had 100,000 daily active users.<ref name="TechCrunch" />

On 24 March 2014, Telegram announced that it had reached 35 million monthly users and 15 million daily active users.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2014/03/24/telegram-hits-35m-monthly-users-15m-daily-with-8b-messages-received-over-30-days/|publisher=TechCrunch|title=Telegram Hits 35M Monthly Users, 15M Daily With 8B Messages Received Over 30 Days|date=24 March 2014|access-date=25 June 2017|archive-date=24 November 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151124123902/http://techcrunch.com/2014/03/24/telegram-hits-35m-monthly-users-15m-daily-with-8b-messages-received-over-30-days/|url-status=live}}</ref> In October 2014, [[South Korea]]n government surveillance plans drove many of its citizens to switch to Telegram from the Korean app [[KakaoTalk]].<ref name="TheVergeKorea" /> In December 2014, Telegram announced that it had 50 million active users, generating 1 billion daily messages, and that it had 1 million new users signing up on its service every week,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/billion|publisher=Telegram|title=Telegram Reaches 1 Billion Daily Messages|date=8 December 2014|access-date=8 December 2014|archive-date=24 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190724110557/https://telegram.org/blog/billion|url-status=live}}</ref> traffic doubled in five months with 2 billion daily messages.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/2-billion|publisher=Telegram|title=Telegram Hits 2 Billion Messages Sent Daily|date=13 May 2015|access-date=31 July 2015|archive-date=12 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512141610/https://telegram.org/blog/2-billion|url-status=live}}</ref> In September 2015, Telegram announced that the app had 60 million active users and delivered 12 billion daily messages.<ref name="TC2015Messages">{{cite web|url = https://techcrunch.com/2015/09/21/telegram-now-seeing-12bn-daily-messages-up-from-1m-in-february/|title = Telegram Now Seeing 12BN Daily Messages, up From 1BN in February|date = 21 September 2015|access-date = 19 November 2015|website = [[Techcrunch]]|last = Lomas|first = Natasha|archive-date = 27 November 2015|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20151127133011/http://techcrunch.com/2015/09/21/telegram-now-seeing-12bn-daily-messages-up-from-1m-in-february/|url-status = live}}</ref>

In February 2016, Telegram announced that it had 100 million monthly active users, with 350,000 new users signing up every day, delivering 15 billion messages daily.<ref>{{cite web|title = Encrypted Messaging App Telegram Hits 100M Monthly Active Users, 350k New Users Each Day|url = https://techcrunch.com/2016/02/23/encrypted-messaging-app-telegram-hits-100m-monthly-active-users-350k-new-users-each-day/|website = TechCrunch|access-date = 23 February 2016|first = Matt|last = Burns|date = 23 February 2016|archive-date = 9 May 2019|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190509222256/https://techcrunch.com/2016/02/23/encrypted-messaging-app-telegram-hits-100m-monthly-active-users-350k-new-users-each-day/|url-status = live}}</ref> In December 2017, Telegram reached 180 million monthly active users.<ref name="Bloomberg-2017-12-12">{{cite news |title = This $5 Billion Encrypted App Isn't for Sale at Any Price |url = https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-12-12/cryptic-russian-crusader-says-his-5-billion-app-can-t-be-bought |newspaper = [[Bloomberg L.P.|Bloomberg]] |date = 12 December 2017 |access-date = 22 December 2017 |archive-date = 20 May 2019 |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190520015516/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-12-12/cryptic-russian-crusader-says-his-5-billion-app-can-t-be-bought |url-status = live }}</ref> By March 2018, that number had doubled, with Telegram reaching 200 million monthly active users.<ref name="TelegramUsersMarch2018">{{cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/200-million|title=200,000,000 Monthly Active Users|date=22 March 2018|website=Telegram|access-date=22 March 2018|archive-date=23 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180923104039/https://telegram.org/blog/200-million|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 14 March 2019, Pavel said that "3 million new users signed up for Telegram within the last 24 hours."<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lomas |first1=Natasha |title=Telegram gets 3M new signups during Facebook apps' outage |url=https://techcrunch.com/2019/03/14/telegram-gets-3m-new-signups-during-facebook-apps-outage/ |website=TechCrunch |date=14 March 2019 |access-date=14 March 2019 |archive-date=2 May 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190502055020/https://techcrunch.com/2019/03/14/telegram-gets-3m-new-signups-during-facebook-apps-outage/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He did not specify what prompted this flood of new sign-ups, but the period matched a prolonged technical outage experienced by Facebook and its family of apps, including Instagram.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Shieber |first1=Jonathan |title=Update: Facebook, Instagram and Messenger were down for many users |url=https://techcrunch.com/2019/03/13/facebook-instagram-and-messenger-are-down-for-some-users/ |website=TechCrunch |date=13 March 2019 |access-date=14 March 2019 |archive-date=2 May 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190502055019/https://techcrunch.com/2019/03/13/facebook-instagram-and-messenger-are-down-for-some-users/ |url-status=live }}</ref> According to the US Securities and Exchange Commission, as of October 2019, Telegram had 300 million monthly active users worldwide.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sec.gov/litigation/complaints/2019/comp-pr2019-212.pdf |title=SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION, ::Plaintiff, :19 Civ. 9439(PKC):-against -:ECF Case:TELEGRAM GROUPINC.andTON ISSUERINC. |date=11 October 2019 |website=The US Securities and Exchange Commission |access-date=17 October 2019 |archive-date=12 November 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201112015601/https://www.sec.gov/litigation/complaints/2019/comp-pr2019-212.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 24 April 2020, Telegram announced that it had reached 400 million monthly active users.<ref name=":6">{{Cite web |title=Telegram hits 500M monthly active users |url=https://t.me/durov/147/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210611161236/https://t.me/durov/147 |archive-date=11 June 2021 |access-date=12 January 2021 |website=Telegram |language=en-US}}</ref>

On 8 January 2021, Pavel announced in a blog post that Telegram had reached "about 500 million" monthly active users.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/respect-your-users-telegram-founder-slams-facebook/article33535421.ece |title= "Respect your users": Telegram founder Pavel Durov slams Facebook |date= 9 January 2021 |website= The Hindu Business Line |access-date= 10 January 2021 |archive-date= 9 January 2021 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20210109093123/https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/respect-your-users-telegram-founder-slams-facebook/article33535421.ece |url-status= live }}</ref> In August, [[TechCrunch]] reported that India was Telegram's largest market, with a 22% share of total installs coming from the region.<ref name= "TCDownloads" /> Telegram then gained over 70 million new users as a result of an [[2021 Facebook outage|outage that affected Facebook and its affiliates]] on 5 October 2021.<ref>{{Cite web| last= Porter| first= Jon| date= 6 October 2021| title= Telegram gains 70M new users in just one day after Facebook outage| url= https://www.theverge.com/2021/10/6/22712191/telegram-70-million-new-users-facebook-outage-surge-whatsapp| access-date= 6 October 2021| website= The Verge| language= en-US| archive-date= 6 October 2021| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20211006143403/https://www.theverge.com/2021/10/6/22712191/telegram-70-million-new-users-facebook-outage-surge-whatsapp| url-status= live}}</ref>
 
On 19 June 2022, Telegram announced that it had reached 700 million monthly active users.<ref name= "700M_premium">{{cite web |last1= Roth |first1= Emma |date= 20 June 2022 |title= Telegram's Premium subscription is here and it costs $4.99 / month |url= https://www.theverge.com/2022/6/19/23174976/telegram-premium-subscription-4-99-month-bigger-uploads-faster-downloads |access-date= 20 June 2022 |website= The Verge}}</ref><ref name= ":4">{{Cite web |date= 21 June 2022 |title= 700 Million Users and Telegram Premium |url= https://telegram.org/blog/700-million-and-premium |access-date= 8 July 2022 |website= Telegram}}</ref>

Telegram surpassed 800 million monthly active users in July 2023<ref name= ":14">{{cite web |last1= Singh |first1= Manish |date= 18 July 2023 |title= Telegram raises $210 million through bond sales |url= https://techcrunch.com/2023/07/18/telegram-raises-210-million-through-bond-sales/ |access-date= 2 August 2023 |website= TechCrunch}}</ref> and reached 900 million in March 2024<ref>{{Cite news |last1= Murphy |first1= Hannah |date= 11 March 2024 |title= Telegram hits 900mn users and nears profitability as founder considers IPO |url= https://www.ft.com/content/8d6ceb0d-4cdb-4165-bdfa-4b95b3e07b2a |url-access= subscription |access-date= 12 March 2024 |website= Financial Times}}</ref> and 950 million in July 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |last= Mehta |first= Ivan |date= 23 July 2024 |title= Telegram's user base climbs to 950M, plans to launch app store |url= https://techcrunch.com/2024/07/23/telegrams-userbase-climbs-to-950m-plans-to-launch-app-store/ |access-date= 23 December 2024 |website= TechCrunch |language= en-US}}</ref> In March 2025, Pavel Durov announced that Telegram had surpassed 1 billion monthly active users.<ref>{{Cite web |title= Pavel Durov |url= https://t.me/durov/404 |access-date= 2025-06-14 |website= Telegram}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last= Mehta |first= Ivan |date= 2025-03-19 |title= Telegram founder Pavel Durov says app now has 1B users, calls WhatsApp a 'cheap, watered down imitation' |url= https://techcrunch.com/2025/03/19/telegram-founder-pavel-durov-says-app-now-has-1b-users-calls-whatsapp-a-cheap-watered-down-imitation/ |access-date= 2025-06-14 |website= TechCrunch |language= en-US}}</ref>

=== 2026 removal from the App Store ===
{{Cleanup reorganize|reason=The new {{Section link|#2026 removal from the App Store}} section doesn't feel like it belongs in the History section, but it also doesn't belong anywhere else in the article. The sections may need to be rethought.|date=August 2026}}

On 3 August 2026, Telegram became unavailable for download from the iPhone and iPad App Store. The removal lasted several hours, during which people who had already installed Telegram could continue using it.<ref name= "Removal-Verge">{{cite news |last= Roth| first= Emma| title= Apple briefly yanked Telegram from the App Store over CSAM violations| url= https://www.theverge.com/tech/974951/telegram-apple-app-store-removed| work= [[The Verge]]| date= 4 August 2026| access-date= 5 August 2026}}</ref> Telegram subsequently announced that the application had returned to the store. An Apple spokesperson said that the company's review had found content violating its strict guidelines against [[child sexual abuse material]] (CSAM). Apple said that Telegram was restored on the same day after its developer removed the content and banned the user who had posted it.<ref name= "Removal-Verge" /> Apple did not publicly give further details about the original report, the location of the material on Telegram, or why the entire application was removed before Telegram was contacted.

Telegram criticized Apple's decision to remove the entire application because of material posted by one user. Telegram spokesperson Remi Vaughn said Apple had been wrong to disrupt legitimate communication by the service's users over the actions of a single person.<ref name= "Removal-Verge" /> Responding to Apple's explanation on [[X (social network)|X]], Telegram questioned whether Apple would apply the same standard equally to all other applications in the App Store. Telegram also linked to its safety overview, which states that the service removes many groups, channels, and pieces of content that violate its terms of service.<ref name= "Telegram-safety">{{cite web |title= Telegram Safety Overview| url= https://telegram.org/safety| website= Telegram| publisher= Telegram FZ-LLC| access-date= 5 August 2026}}</ref> Telegram said it had blocked more than 337,900 groups and channels associated with CSAM during 2026 by the time of the incident. That figure has not been independently audited.<ref name= "Removal-Verge" /> [[Epic Games]] chief executive [[Tim Sweeney (game developer)|Tim Sweeney]] questioned how large-scale communication services could operate if a single user's illegal post was sufficient for an entire application to be removed. He also questioned whether Apple would apply the same standard to its own [[iMessage]] service.{{Citation needed|date=August 2026}}

On 4 August, Telegram founder [[Pavel Durov]] alleged that the prohibited material had been deliberately placed in a public group by a person engaged in what he called "takedown extortion". According to Durov, such attackers demand payment from the administrators of online communities and threaten to plant illegal material and report it to application-store operators if payment is refused. Durov said the person responsible for the incident had inserted AI-modified illegal material by editing an older message in an active group. He said this made the material difficult for ordinary group members to notice and report. Durov also criticized Apple, saying it removed Telegram before contacting the company. He argued that the decision created a systemic risk for any application hosting [[user-generated content]], because coordinated attackers could attempt to cause the removal of legitimate applications or online communities by planting prohibited material.<ref>{{Cite web |last= Washenko |first= Anna |date= 2026-08-04 |title= Telegram CEO says 'takedown extortionist' was responsible for the app being briefly delisted by Apple |url= https://www.engadget.com/2230482/telegram-ceo-says-takedown-extortionist-was-responsible-for-the-app-being-briefly-delisted-by-apple/ |access-date= 2026-08-26 |website= Engadget |language= en-US}}</ref> Apple did not confirm Durov's account of the incident.

== Features ==
=== Messaging ===
[[File:Telegram-account-self-destruction.png|thumb|Account self-destruction option.]]
To use Telegram, a user must sign up with their [[Telephone|phone]] number or an anonymous +888 number purchased from the Fragment blockchain platform.<ref name="Lopez">{{cite web |last=Lopez |first=Miguel |date=30 January 2014 |title=Configurando Telegram en el iPhone, en la web y en el Mac |trans-title=Configuring Telegram in the Apple iPhone, the Web and the Mac |url=http://www.applesfera.com/aplicaciones-ios-1/configurando-telegram-en-el-iphone-en-la-web-y-en-el-mac |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190807133141/https://www.applesfera.com/aplicaciones-ios-1/configurando-telegram-en-el-iphone-en-la-web-y-en-el-mac |archive-date=7 August 2019 |access-date=4 December 2014 |publisher=Applesfera |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mehta |first=Ivan |date=7 December 2022 |title=Telegram is auctioning phone numbers to let users sign up to the service without any SIM |url=https://techcrunch.com/2022/12/07/telegram-is-auctioning-phone-numbers-to-let-users-sign-up-to-the-service-without-any-sim/ |access-date=9 December 2022 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}}</ref> Changing the phone number in the app will automatically reassign the user's account to that number without exporting data or notifying their contacts.<ref name="Lopez" /><ref name="way-transf">{{cite web |last=Munizaga |first=Jonathan |date=1 December 2014 |title=Telegram ya permite migrar conversaciones y contactos a una línea nueva |trans-title=Telegram already allows migrating conversations and contacts to a new line |url=http://www.wayerless.com/2014/12/telegram-se-actualiza-permitiendo-ahora-migrar-tus-conversaciones-y-contactos-a-una-linea-nueva/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141219220850/http://www.wayerless.com/2014/12/telegram-se-actualiza-permitiendo-ahora-migrar-tus-conversaciones-y-contactos-a-una-linea-nueva/ |archive-date=19 December 2014 |access-date=2 December 2014 |publisher=Wayerless |language=es }}</ref><ref name="te-transf">{{cite web |last=Mateo |first=David G |date=1 December 2014 |title=Telegram ahora permite traspasar mensajes al cambiar de número |url=http://www.tuexpertoapps.com/2014/12/02/telegram-ahora-permite-traspasar-mensajes-al-cambiar-de-numero/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512143429/https://www.tuexpertoapps.com/2014/12/02/telegram-ahora-permite-traspasar-mensajes-al-cambiar-de-numero/ |archive-date=12 May 2019 |access-date=2 December 2014 |publisher=TuExperto |language=es}}</ref> Phone numbers are hidden by default, with only a user's contacts able to see them. Sign-ups can be done only on an Android or iOS device.<ref name="BusinessInsider-2021">{{cite web |last=Witman |first=Emma |date=22 January 2021 |title=How to make a Telegram account and start using the popular group chatting app |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/how-to-make-a-telegram-account |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210209074302/https://www.businessinsider.com/how-to-make-a-telegram-account |archive-date=9 February 2021 |access-date=28 May 2021 |website=Business Insider}}</ref><ref name="desktop-login">{{cite web |title=no login by sms code in desktop version |url=https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/issues/16153 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211028101131/https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/issues/16153 |archive-date=28 October 2021 |access-date=10 July 2021 |website=[[GitHub]]}}</ref>

Messages users send and receive are tied to their numbers and custom usernames,<ref name="cs2.0">{{cite web |date=23 October 2014 |title=Secure Messaging App Telegram Adds Usernames And Snapchat-Like Hold-To-View For Media |url=https://techcrunch.com/2014/10/23/secure-messaging-app-telegram-adds-usernames-and-snapchat-like-hold-to-view-for-media/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512143411/https://techcrunch.com/2014/10/23/secure-messaging-app-telegram-adds-usernames-and-snapchat-like-hold-to-view-for-media/ |archive-date=12 May 2019 |access-date=23 October 2014 |publisher=Techcrunch}}</ref> not the device. Telegram content is synced between users' [[Login|logged-in]] devices automatically through cloud storage, except for device-specific secret chats. By default, any account that is inactive for 6 months is deleted, but the period can be shortened or extended up to 18 months. Telegram allows groups, bots and channels with a verified social media or Wikipedia page to be verified, but not individual user accounts.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Page Verification Guidelines |url=https://telegram.org/verify |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210114070820/https://telegram.org/verify |archive-date=14 January 2021 |access-date=12 January 2021 |website=Telegram}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=3 April 2020 |title=Coronavirus News and Verified Channels |url=https://telegram.org/blog/coronavirus |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210122205226/https://telegram.org/blog/coronavirus |archive-date=22 January 2021 |access-date=12 January 2021 |website=Telegram}}</ref>

Messages can contain formatted text, media, files up to 2 GB (4 GB with Premium), locations, and audio or video messages recorded in-app. Telegram messages in private chats can be edited for up to 48 hours; an "edited" icon indicates changes. Messages may also be deleted for both sides without a trace. Users may delete messages and whole chats for both themselves and other participants. Chats can be exported to preserve them via Telegram's Desktop client, but the saved data cannot be imported back into the user's account.

Users can import chat history, including both messages and media, from WhatsApp, Line, and [[KakaoTalk]] due to [[data portability]], making a new chat to hold the messages or adding them to an existing one.<ref>{{Cite web |date=31 January 2021 |title=آخرین میخ تلگرام بر تابوت واتساپ |url=https://www.eghtesadonline.com/بخش-فناوری-64/502325-آخرین-میخ-تلگرام-بر-تابوت-واتس-اپ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210205175049/https://www.eghtesadonline.com/%D8%A8%D8%AE%D8%B4-%D9%81%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%88%D8%B1%DB%8C-64/502325-%D8%A2%D8%AE%D8%B1%DB%8C%D9%86-%D9%85%DB%8C%D8%AE-%D8%AA%D9%84%DA%AF%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%BE |archive-date=5 February 2021 |access-date=1 February 2021 |website=اقتصاد آنلاین |language=fa}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Telegram's latest update lets you import chat history from other apps |url=https://www.gsmarena.com/telegrams_latest_update_lets_you_import_chat_history_from_other_apps-news-47472.php |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210131214359/https://www.gsmarena.com/telegrams_latest_update_lets_you_import_chat_history_from_other_apps-news-47472.php |archive-date=31 January 2021 |access-date=1 February 2021 |website=GSMArena.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

As users can be logged into many devices at once, starting to type a message on one of them will create a "cloud draft" that syncs with others, so that typing can be started on a phone and finished on a laptop, for example.<ref name="Drafts">{{Cite web |date=14 June 2016 |title=Telegram rolls out message drafts, picture in picture for iOS, video player for Android |url=https://venturebeat.com/2016/06/14/telegram-rolls-out-message-drafts-picture-in-picture-for-ios-video-player-for-android/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210525092951/https://venturebeat.com/2016/06/14/telegram-rolls-out-message-drafts-picture-in-picture-for-ios-video-player-for-android/ |archive-date=25 May 2021 |access-date=25 May 2021 |publisher=VentureBeat}}</ref>

Any message can be translated by opening the context menu. Premium users can translate a whole chat with one click. Users can hide the translate button for messages written in specific languages.

Reactions can be used to respond to a message with emoji. Premium users have access to more reaction choices and can leave more reactions per message. Reactions are always on in private chats and can be enabled by admins in groups and channels. Specific reactions can be allowed or excluded. Reaction emoji play an animation with special effects.<ref name="xda-developers.com">{{Cite web |date=20 September 2022 |title=Telegram's new update brings more emoji fun and lots of quality of life improvements |url=https://www.xda-developers.com/telegram-update-for-september-2022/ |access-date=20 September 2022 |website=XDA |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Schoon |first1=Ben |date=30 December 2021 |title=Telegram adds message reactions, bigger emoji animations, and more in latest update |url=https://9to5google.com/2021/12/30/telegram-adds-message-reactions-bigger-emoji-animations-and-more-in-latest-update/ |access-date=16 May 2022 |website=9to5Google}}</ref>

Users can also send stickers, which can be static, animated or video.<ref name="XDAVideoStickers">{{cite web |last1=Itani |first1=Mahmoud |date=1 February 2022 |title=Telegram introduces video stickers, improved reactions, and more |url=https://www.xda-developers.com/telegram-video-stickers-improved-reactions/ |access-date=16 May 2022 |website=XDA}}</ref> Sticker packs are made by Telegram designers as well as regular users and can be shared via links. They use the [[WebP]]<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=25 June 2021 |title=Animated Backgrounds |url=https://telegram.org/blog/animated-backgrounds |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210626105339/https://telegram.org/blog/animated-backgrounds |archive-date=26 June 2021 |access-date=27 June 2021 |website=Telegram}}</ref> or [[WebM]] format and do not require special software to create or upload. Some stickers feature full-screen effects that play out when first sent or when tapped.

Users can schedule messages to send at a particular time or when their conversation partner comes online,<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 January 2020 |title=Telegram 5.13 update brings Theme Editor 2.0, "Send when online", verifiable builds, and more |url=https://www.xda-developers.com/telegram-5-13-update-brings-theme-editor-2-0-more/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209123902/https://www.xda-developers.com/telegram-5-13-update-brings-theme-editor-2-0-more/ |archive-date=9 December 2020 |access-date=7 August 2020}}</ref> as well as choose to send a message "without sound" without a notification. Messages from private chats can be forwarded, with an option to hide the original sender's identity or to hide captions from media messages. Forwarded messages also maintain reply formatting, able to show which messages in a thread are replying to others. Any user can also send a message to a special "Saved Messages" chat as a form of bookmarking them. The contents of the chat are only visible to the user.

Chats can be sorted into folders to organize them with preset options like "Unread" and "Muted" or custom separations such as "Work" and "Family". Premium users have the ability to set any chat folder as the default screen in the app while regular users will always see the full chat list when first opening the app.[[File:A "secret chat" confirmation notice in Telegram.jpg|thumb|394x394px|A "secret chat" confirmation notice – screenshot from [[iOS 16]]]]
Users have the option to start a one-on-one, end-to-end-encrypted "Secret Chat",<ref name="techfaq" /> which remains accessible only on the device on which it started and self-destructs upon logging out.<ref name="TechCrunch" /><ref name="how-secure">{{cite web |title=FAQ: How secure is Telegram? |url=https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-secure-is-telegram |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140209082001/https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-secure-is-telegram |archive-date=9 February 2014 |access-date=10 February 2014 |work=Telegram official website}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Description of MTProto Mobile Protocol |url=https://core.telegram.org/mtproto |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141006104149/https://core.telegram.org/mtproto |archive-date=6 October 2014 |access-date=7 March 2014 |publisher=Telegram}}</ref> Secret Chats restrict screenshotting by Android devices and warn when one is taken on an iOS device, while also hiding the chat contents from the final image.<ref name="Verge2014" /> Secret Chats support [[Perfect Forward Secrecy|perfect forward secrecy]] and switch encryption keys after a key has been used 100 times or a week has passed.<ref>{{harvnb|Rottermanner|Kieseberg|Huber|Schmiedecker|2015|p=2}}</ref><ref name="way-transf" /><ref name="te-transf" /><ref>{{cite web |date=14 December 2014 |title=Perfect Forward Secrecy |url=https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/pfs |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191107005120/https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/pfs |archive-date=7 November 2019 |access-date=14 December 2014 |publisher=Telegram}}</ref><ref name="Rottermanner-2015-p6">{{harvnb|Rottermanner|Kieseberg|Huber|Schmiedecker|2015|p=6}}</ref> Secret Chats are available only on Android, iOS, and macOS clients.<ref>{{cite web |date=2 July 2015 |title=Github issue 871: missing secret chats |url=https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/issues/871 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190502055013/https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/issues/871 |archive-date=2 May 2019 |access-date=25 July 2017 |website=[[GitHub]]}}</ref>

Both in Secret and regular chats, messages can self-destruct after they are read, disappearing for all parties after a period set by the user, ranging from one day to one year.<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 February 2021 |title=How Telegram's new update is making messages private |url=https://www.livemint.com/technology/tech-news/how-telegram-s-new-update-is-making-messages-private-11614388851319.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210228184333/https://www.livemint.com/technology/tech-news/how-telegram-s-new-update-is-making-messages-private-11614388851319.html |archive-date=28 February 2021 |access-date=1 March 2021 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Telegram Unsend Messages">{{cite web |date=3 January 2017 |title=Unsend Messages, Network Usage, and More |url=https://telegram.org/blog/unsend-and-usage |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191210213549/https://telegram.org/blog/unsend-and-usage |archive-date=10 December 2019 |access-date=4 April 2017 |publisher=Telegram}}</ref>

=== Groups and channels ===
Telegram users can create and join groups and channels. Groups are large multi-user chats that support up to 200,000 members and can be public or private. Users can freely join public chats and find them using the in-app search function, while private chats require an invitation. They support flexible admin rights and can use bots for [[content moderation|moderation]] to prevent spam and unwanted activity. Groups can be split into topics, effectively creating subgroups dedicated to various subjects with separate settings for each.<ref>{{Cite web |author1=Nickolas Diaz |date=7 November 2022 |title=Telegram drops an update, adds topics in groups, Voice-to-Text, and new emoji packs |url=https://www.androidcentral.com/apps-software/telegram-update-voice-to-text-video-group-topics-collectible-usernames |access-date=17 December 2023 |website=Android Central |language=en}}</ref>

Admins can choose to hide the list of members in a group, as well as post anonymously themselves.<ref name="APSearchComments">{{cite web |last=Potts |first=Caleb |date=30 September 2020 |title=Telegram adds search filters, anonymous admins, channel replies, and more |url=https://www.androidpolice.com/2020/09/30/telegram-adds-search-filters-anonymous-admins-channel-replies-and-more/ |website=Android Police |access-date=17 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210125050457/https://www.androidpolice.com/2020/09/30/telegram-adds-search-filters-anonymous-admins-channel-replies-and-more/ |archive-date=25 January 2021 |url-status=live}}</ref> Similarly, groups and channels can have content protection enabled, which prevents screenshots, forwarding and downloading of media.<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 December 2021 |title=Telegram monthly update brings Content Protection and Delete by Date feature |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/technology/social/telegram-monthly-update-brings-content-protection-and-delete-by-date-feature-7662617/ |access-date=17 December 2023 |website=The Indian Express |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Gatlan |first=Sergiu |date=8 December 2021 |title=Telegram adds content protection support for groups and channels |url=https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/software/telegram-adds-content-protection-support-for-groups-and-channels/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211223225101/https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/software/telegram-adds-content-protection-support-for-groups-and-channels/ |archive-date=23 December 2021 |access-date=27 December 2021 |website=Bleeping Computer |language=en-US}}</ref> Ownership of channels and groups can be transferred to one of the admins if the owner wishes to give up their rights.

Groups support threaded replies, where bringing up the context menu on a message allows one to open a screen with a thread of replies made to that message and the subsequent ones in the thread. Specific users can be tagged in the group by adding @username to a message, where "username" is that particular user's username.

Groups and channels also support polls, which can be open or anonymous and can support multiple choices. When forwarded, polls retain the answer data and any votes cast in other chats will count toward the overall total.<ref>{{Cite web |date=24 January 2020 |title=Telegram introduces a new feature that WhatsApp doesn't have: Poll 2.0 |url=https://tech.hindustantimes.com/tech/news/telegram-introduces-a-new-feature-that-whatsapp-doesn-t-have-poll-2-0-story-pOkzTJb1xvPl87Ic5ya9XI.html |access-date=17 December 2023 |website=HT Tech |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=23 January 2020 |title=Telegram 5.14 adds multiple-answer and quiz polls (APK Download) |url=https://www.androidpolice.com/2020/01/23/telegram-5-14-adds-multiple-answer-and-quiz-polls-apk-download/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210603124745/https://www.androidpolice.com/2020/01/23/telegram-5-14-adds-multiple-answer-and-quiz-polls-apk-download/ |archive-date=3 June 2021 |access-date=3 June 2021 |website=Android Police}}</ref>

Channels are one-way feeds where the channel owner or admins can post content while followers can only read, react and comment, if comments have been enabled.<ref name="APSearchComments" /><ref>{{cite web |date=1 June 2019 |title=Telegram 5.7 further enhances privacy, improves group and channel features, and more |url=https://www.androidpolice.com/2019/06/01/telegram-5-7-further-enhances-privacy-improves-group-and-channel-features-and-more/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210525092954/https://www.androidpolice.com/2019/06/01/telegram-5-7-further-enhances-privacy-improves-group-and-channel-features-and-more/ |archive-date=25 May 2021 |access-date=25 May 2021 |website=Android Police}}</ref> Channels can be created for broadcasting messages to an unlimited number of subscribers.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Lobao |first1=Martim |date=22 September 2015 |title=Telegram v3.2 Brings Channels For Broadcasting Your Messages To The World |work=Android Police |url=http://www.androidpolice.com/2015/09/22/telegram-v3-2-brings-channels-broadcasting-messages-world/ |url-status=live |access-date=5 February 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512175942/https://www.androidpolice.com/2015/09/22/telegram-v3-2-brings-channels-broadcasting-messages-world/ |archive-date=12 May 2019}}</ref> The list of those who subscribe to a channel can only be seen by its admins. Posting in the channel is anonymous, though admins can choose to add signatures to their posts. Channels offer detailed statistics on view counts, user growth and interactions, also visible only to admins.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 December 2023 |title=Telegram 6.0 adds chat folders, channel statistics, and more |url=https://www.neowin.net/news/telegram-60-adds-chat-folders-channel-statistics-and-more/ |access-date=17 December 2023 |website=Neowin |language=en}}</ref>

Channel owners are able to use Telegram to create giveaways, randomly awarding channel members with prizes such as Telegram Premium subscriptions to their followers, based on certain criteria.<ref name="PhoneArenaGiveaways">{{Cite web |last=Vasile |first=Cosmin |date=7 November 2023 |title=Telegram update brings the ability to host giveaways |url=https://www.phonearena.com/news/telegram-update-channel-giveaways_id152336 |access-date=7 November 2023 |website=PhoneArena |language=en-US}}</ref> Users with a Telegram Premium subscription have a number of "boosts" that they can give to channels, which allow the channel to "level up" and unlock features, such as the ability to customize messages or post stories as the channel.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kellen |date=22 September 2023 |title=Telegram Adds Stories for Channels Where You Have All the Power |url=https://www.droid-life.com/2023/09/22/telegram-channel-stories-boost/ |access-date=17 December 2023 |website=www.droid-life.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

In December 2019, [[Bloomberg News]] moved their messenger-based newsletter service from [[WhatsApp]] to Telegram after the former banned bulk and automated messaging.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-12-04/how-to-follow-bloomberg-on-telegram|title=How to Follow Bloomberg on Telegram|last=Hess|first=Megan|date=3 December 2019|newspaper=Bloomberg.com|access-date=10 January 2020|archive-date=8 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201208134608/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-12-04/how-to-follow-bloomberg-on-telegram|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{cite web|url=https://digiday.com/media/bloomberg-news-using-telegram/|title=How Bloomberg News is using Telegram|last=Ting|first=Deanna|date=10 January 2020|website=Digiday|language=en-US|access-date=10 January 2020|archive-date=9 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209095859/https://digiday.com/media/bloomberg-news-using-telegram/|url-status=live}}</ref> Other news services with official channels on the platform include the ''[[Financial Times]]'',<ref>{{cite web |title=Join the FT Telegram channel to receive Ukraine coverage alerts |url=https://www.ft.com/telegram |website=Financial Times |date=24 March 2020 |access-date=1 May 2022}}</ref> ''[[Business Insider]]''<ref>{{cite web |last1=Mahal |first1=Pavan |title=Sign up for Telegram updates from Business Insider |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/sign-up-for-telegram-updates-business-insider-2021-1 |website=Business Insider |access-date=1 May 2022}}</ref> and ''[[The New York Times]]''.<ref>{{cite news |title=The New York Times launches a Telegram channel to deliver news about the war. |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2022/03/14/world/europe/telegram-nyt.html |website=The New York Times |date=14 March 2022 |access-date=1 May 2022}}</ref>

Channels have also been used by governments and heads of state. Notable examples include [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]<ref name="TimeZelenskyy">{{cite magazine |last1=Bergengruen |first1=Vera |date=21 March 2022 |title=How Telegram Became the Digital Battlefield in the Russia-Ukraine War |url=https://time.com/6158437/telegram-russia-ukraine-information-war/ |access-date=1 May 2022 |magazine=TIME |archive-date=28 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221128122847/https://time.com/6158437/telegram-russia-ukraine-information-war/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> and [[Emmanuel Macron]].<ref name="MacronTelegram">{{cite web |title=Telegram: Contact @emmanuelmacron |url=https://t.me/emmanuelmacron |website=Telegram |access-date=1 May 2022}}</ref> Channels have been used by journalists in oppressive regimes to establish independent news networks.<ref>{{cite magazine |last1=Ptak |first1=Guillaume |title=The Telegram-Powered News Outlet Waging Guerrilla War on Russia |url=https://www.wired.com/story/february-morning-russia-ukraine-war/ |magazine=Wired |date=29 August 2022 |access-date=30 August 2022}}</ref>

=== Telegram Mini Apps ===
Telegram also provides an open [[API]] for the creation of custom bots which can perform various tasks, integrate other services into Telegram chats, or work as mini apps or games.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Telegram Games |url=https://t.me/gam8s |access-date=20 May 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=17 November 2023 |title=From Bots to Mini Apps: Unveiling Telegram's Web3 Ecosystem |url=https://topco.medium.com/from-bots-to-mini-apps-unveiling-telegrams-web3-ecosystem-edea254f9b5f |access-date=20 May 2024 |website=Medium |language=en}}</ref> In July 2024, Telegram Mini Apps reached 500 million monthly active users.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.blockchaingamer.biz/news/35861/animoca-reports-34-million-active-ton-wallets/ | title=Animoca reports 34 million active wallets on TON | date=3 December 2024 }}</ref>

=== Video and voice calls ===
Since 2017, Telegram users have been able to initiate one-on-one calls in private chats. Calls are end-to-end encrypted and prioritize [[peer-to-peer]] connections. Video calls were introduced in August 2020.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lyons |first=Kim |date=15 August 2020 |title=Telegram launches one-on-one video calls on iOS and Android |url=https://www.theverge.com/2020/8/15/21370420/telegram-video-calls-os-android |access-date=28 January 2024 |website=The Verge |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=O'Flaherty |first=Kate |title=Telegram Just Launched A Major New Feature To Beat Zoom |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/kateoflahertyuk/2020/08/16/telegram-just-launched-a-major-new-feature-to-beat-zoom/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209111454/https://www.forbes.com/sites/kateoflahertyuk/2020/08/16/telegram-just-launched-a-major-new-feature-to-beat-zoom/ |archive-date=9 December 2020 |access-date=3 September 2020 |website=Forbes |language=en}}</ref> According to Telegram, there is a [[Artificial neural network|neural network]] working to learn various technical parameters about a call to provide better quality of service for future uses.<ref name="Telegram Voice Calls">{{cite web |url=https://techcrunch.com/2017/03/30/telegram-call/ |publisher=TechCrunch |title=Telegram introduces voice calls, touting end-to-end encryption |date=30 March 2017 |access-date=25 May 2021 |archive-date=25 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210525092951/https://techcrunch.com/2017/03/30/telegram-call/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Telegram added group voice chats in December 2020<ref name="VergeVoiceChats">{{Cite web |last=Warren |first=Tom |date=23 December 2020 |title=Telegram gets Discord-like group voice chats |url=https://www.theverge.com/2020/12/23/22196894/telegram-voice-chats-group-discord-feature |access-date=23 December 2020 |website=The Verge |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201223172226/https://www.theverge.com/2020/12/23/22196894/telegram-voice-chats-group-discord-feature |archive-date=23 December 2020 |url-status=live}}</ref> and group video chats in June 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Serrano |first=Jody |date=27 June 2021 |title=A Year Later, Telegram Finally Launches the Group Video Calls It Promised |url=https://gizmodo.com.au/2021/06/a-year-later-telegram-finally-launches-the-group-video-calls-it-promised/ |access-date=28 January 2024 |website=Gizmodo Australia |language=en-AU}}</ref> Group voice and video chats support picture-in-picture video, as well as sharing one's screen, creating a recording of the call, noise suppression and selective muting.<ref>{{cite web |last=Kew-Denniss |first=Zachary |date=25 June 2021 |title=Group video calls and animated backgrounds are finally here in Telegram 7.8 |url=https://www.androidpolice.com/2021/06/25/telegram-beta-7-8-adds-video-and-screen-sharing-in-groups/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210625191110/https://www.androidpolice.com/2021/06/25/telegram-beta-7-8-adds-video-and-screen-sharing-in-groups/ |archive-date=25 June 2021 |access-date=26 June 2021 |work=Android Police}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Lyons |first=Kim |date=26 June 2021 |title=Telegram adds group video calling at last |url=https://www.theverge.com/2021/6/26/22551652/telegram-adds-group-video-calling-chat |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210626140818/https://www.theverge.com/2021/6/26/22551652/telegram-adds-group-video-calling-chat |archive-date=26 June 2021 |access-date=26 June 2021 |work=The Verge}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=25 June 2021 |title=Group Video Calls |url=https://telegram.org/blog/group-video-calls |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210625224638/https://telegram.org/blog/group-video-calls |archive-date=25 June 2021 |access-date=27 June 2021 |website=Telegram}}</ref> In channels, users can start a [[Live streaming|livestream]], that is able to integrate with third-party apps such as [[OBS Studio]] and [[XSplit]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://telegram.org/blog/live-streams-forwarding-next-channel |title=Live Streams, Flexible Forwarding, Jump to Next Channel, Trending Stickers and More |date=31 August 2021 |access-date=8 December 2021 |archive-date=8 December 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211208183034/https://telegram.org/blog/live-streams-forwarding-next-channel |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Bonggolto |first1=Jay |title=Telegram picks up a new download manager and redesigns its attachment menu |url=https://www.androidcentral.com/telegram-update-download-manager-attachment-menu-live-streaming-with-third-party-apps |website=Android Central |date=11 March 2022 |access-date=21 May 2022}}</ref>

Once launched, a group voice chat will remain active and open to all group members until an admin specifically closes it.<ref name="VergeVoiceChats" />

=== Privacy and security features ===
By default, logging into Telegram requires either an SMS message sent to the registered number or a code message sent to one of the active sessions on another device. Users have the option to set a two-step verification password and add a recovery email.<ref>{{Cite magazine |author=Yasmin Ahmed |date=5 June 2020 |title=Telegram adds two-step verification for better security, launches in-app video editor to platform |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/technology/news/story/telegram-adds-two-step-verification-for-better-security-launches-in-app-video-editor-to-platform-1685933-2020-06-05 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201219051314/https://www.indiatoday.in/technology/news/story/telegram-adds-two-step-verification-for-better-security-launches-in-app-video-editor-to-platform-1685933-2020-06-05 |archive-date=19 December 2020 |access-date=11 December 2020 |magazine=India Today |language=en}}</ref> In late 2022, options to ''[[Sign in with Apple]]'' and ''Sign In with Google'' or with an email address were added.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Beta Info English |url=https://t.me/s/betainfoen/1032 |access-date=18 January 2023 |website=Telegram}}</ref> Whenever a new device successfully logs in to a user's account, a special service notification is sent and a login alert is displayed in the chat list of their other devices.<ref name="w550">{{cite web | title=Stories in Channels, View-Once Media and More | website=Telegram | date=September 22, 2023 | url=https://telegram.org/blog/channel-stories | access-date=October 8, 2025}}</ref>

In the ''Privacy and Security'' submenu of Settings, users have the option to hide their "Last Seen" status,<ref>{{Cite web |title=How to Hide Last Seen on Telegram |url=https://www.alphr.com/how-to-hide-last-seen-on-telegram/ |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=Alphr |date=6 June 2023 |language=en-US}}</ref> which reflects the last time the user opened a Telegram app. Hiding the status obfuscates the exact time the user was online and hides the statuses of other people respectively. Similarly, users can hide their phone number and profile photo from people based on categories such as Non-Contacts or by adding exceptions. When a user chooses to hide their profile photo, they can set an alternative "Public Profile Picture" that will be shown instead.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kellen |date=30 December 2022 |title=Telegram's 10 New Features are Its Best in a While |url=https://www.droid-life.com/2022/12/30/telegram-update-adds-spoiler-alerts-profile-pic-controls-and-lots-more/ |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=www.droid-life.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

In the same menu, users can restrict the circle of people who can call them or invite them to groups and channels, while Premium users also have the option to restrict who can send them text and voice messages.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Espósito |first=Filipe |date=13 August 2022 |title=Telegram update approved in App Store after Apple complained about animated emoji |url=https://9to5mac.com/2022/08/13/telegram-app-store-apple-complained-emoji/ |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=9to5Mac}}</ref>

The ''Devices'' submenu shows all of the active devices on a user's account and allows them to remotely log out from those devices.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Gilbert |first1=Jon |last2=Mascellino |first2=Alessandro |date=22 March 2022 |title=Top 10 tips for using Telegram safely and securely |url=https://www.androidpolice.com/top-tips-using-telegram-safely-securely/ |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=Android Police |language=en}}</ref>

=== Data and storage settings ===
Telegram clients can turn off media autoplay and automatic downloads for both WiFi and mobile data, adjusting them for media type and size. Auto download settings can also be applied based on chat type such as group, channel or private.

Cache settings can be changed to automatically clear the cache once it reaches a certain size or a certain time passes. The interface shows users a visual representation of their storage usage and also lets them sort their cached media by size to clear specific items.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Potuck |first=Michael |date=30 December 2022 |title=Telegram for iOS gets new drawing and text tools, updates for hidden media, zero storage use, more |url=https://9to5mac.com/2022/12/30/telegram-ios-update-2/ |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=9to5Mac}}</ref>

=== Bots ===
In June 2015, Telegram launched a platform for third-party developers to create [[IM bot|bots]].<ref name="Telegram Bot Platform">{{cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/bot-revolution|publisher=Telegram|title=Telegram Bot Platform|date=24 June 2015|access-date=1 September 2015|archive-date=12 December 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191212053626/https://telegram.org/blog/bot-revolution|url-status=live}}</ref> Bots are Telegram accounts operated by programs. They can respond to messages or [[Mention (blogging)|mentions]] directly or can be invited into groups, and are able to perform tasks, integrate with other programs and host mini apps.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Liao |first=Rita |date=26 September 2023 |title=Telegram starts to look like a super app, echoing WeChat |url=https://techcrunch.com/2023/09/25/telegram-wechat-super-app-ton-foundation/ |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Telegram Mini Apps |url=https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=core.telegram.org}}</ref> Bots can accept [[online payment]]s made with credit cards or [[Apple Pay]].<ref name="TelegramPayments">{{cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/payments|title=Payments for Bots|website=Telegram|date=18 May 2017|access-date=12 February 2018|archive-date=9 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190509215757/https://telegram.org/blog/payments|url-status=live}}</ref> The Dutch website ''[[Tweakers]]'' reported that an invited bot can potentially read all group messages, when the bot controller changes the access settings silently at a later point in time. Telegram pointed out that it considered implementing a feature that would announce such a status change within the relevant group.<ref>{{cite news|url = http://tweakers.net/nieuws/104386/telegram-bots-kunnen-relatief-ongemerkt-meelezen-in-groepsgesprekken.html|title = Telegram-bots kunnen relatief ongemerkt meelezen in groepsgesprekken|date = 23 July 2015|access-date = 25 October 2015|website = [[Tweakers]]|last = Schellevis|first = Joost|language = nl|archive-date = 12 May 2019|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190512150205/https://tweakers.net/nieuws/104386/telegram-bots-kunnen-relatief-ongemerkt-meelezen-in-groepsgesprekken.html|url-status = live}}</ref>

There are also inline bots, which can be used from any chat screen. To activate an inline bot, a user must type the bot's username and a query in the message field. The bot then will offer its content. The user can choose from that content and send it within a chat.<ref name="Inline Bots">{{cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/inline-bots|publisher=Telegram|title=Introducing Inline Bots|date=4 January 2016|access-date=4 April 2017|archive-date=9 August 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190809155850/https://telegram.org/blog/inline-bots|url-status=live}}</ref> Certain approved bots are also able to integrate into the attachment menu, making them accessible in any chat.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Launching Mini Apps from the Attachment Menu |url=https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#launching-mini-apps-from-the-attachment-menu |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=core.telegram.org}}</ref>

Bots can handle transactions provided by [[Paymentwall]], [[Yandex.Money]], [[Stripe (company)|Stripe]], Ravepay, Razorpay, QiWi and [[Google Pay (payment method)|Google Pay]] for different countries.<ref name="TelegramPayments" /> Bots power Telegram's gaming platform, which utilizes HTML5, so games are loaded on-demand as needed, like ordinary webpages. Games work on iPhone 4 and newer, and on Android 4.4 devices and newer.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/games|title=Gaming Platform 1.0|date=3 October 2016|website=Telegram|access-date=16 August 2020|archive-date=9 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200809190314/https://telegram.org/blog/games|url-status=live}}</ref>

People can use [[Internet Of Things]] (IoT) services with two-way interaction via [[IFTTT]] implemented within Telegram.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/pin-and-ifttt|title=Pinned Chats and IFTTT Integrations|date=7 December 2016|website=Telegram|access-date=16 August 2020|archive-date=9 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209081235/https://telegram.org/blog/pin-and-ifttt|url-status=live}}</ref>
[[File:Telegram android app test receipt order Screenshot 20210627.png|alt=app window user interface shows shipment address, name, price, payment software|thumb|Test order receipt]]
In April 2021, the Payments 2.0 upgrade enabled bot payments within any chat, using third-party services such as Sberbank, Tranzoo, Payme, CLICK, LiqPay and ECOMMPAY to process the credit card information.<ref>{{Cite web|date=27 April 2021|title=Telegram now lets retailers accept credit cards in any chat|url=https://www.windowscentral.com/telegram-adds-new-payment-features-latest-update|access-date=27 April 2021|website=Windows Central|language=en|archive-date=27 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210427155309/https://www.windowscentral.com/telegram-adds-new-payment-features-latest-update|url-status=live}}</ref>

Bots are also commonly used for businesses to communicate with customers as the bot APIs integrate with communication platforms so that Telegram messages can be sent and received in an [[omnichannel]]inbox. These platforms also enable businesses to add Telegram chat widget to their websites and gives them the option to automate conversations or let human agents reply. Examples of platforms providing Telegram bot integration include respond.io, Manychat and Trengo.<ref>{{cite web |title=Malaysia-based Respond.io helps businesses juggle multiple messaging apps |url=https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/20/malaysia-based-respond-io-helps-businesses-juggle-multiple-messaging-apps/ |website=TechCrunch |access-date=8 July 2025 |date=September 20, 2022}}</ref>

In February 2018, Telegram launched its [[social login]] feature, Telegram Login. It features a website widget that can be embedded into websites, allowing users to sign into a third party website with their Telegram account. The gateway sends the user's Telegram name, username, and profile picture to the website owner, while the user's phone number remains hidden. The gateway is integrated with a bot, which is linked with the developer's specific website domain.<ref name="Neowin48">{{Cite news|title=Telegram 4.8 arrives with Telegram Login and streaming|language=en|work=Neowin|url=https://www.neowin.net/news/telegram-48-arrives-with-telegram-login-and-streaming|access-date=12 February 2018|archive-date=18 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190518221145/https://www.neowin.net/news/telegram-48-arrives-with-telegram-login-and-streaming|url-status=live}}</ref>

In June 2021, an update introduced a new bot menu where users can browse and send commands while in a chat with a bot.<ref name=":2"/>

In April 2022, bots gained support for customized interfaces and inline page loading. Interfaces can be adjusted to match the app's theme even if it changes while interacting with the bot.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 April 2022 |title=Notification Sounds, Bot Revolution and More |url=https://telegram.org/blog/notifications-bots |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref>

In October 2024, Telegram added increased messaging limits for bots, allowing bots to send up to 1000 messages per second to their users. Messages beyond the free limit of 30 per second are paid for using Telegram Stars.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Telegram update brings Faster video loading, Playback speed options, Last edit timestamps and more |url=https://www.fonearena.com/blog/439282/telegram-faster-video-loading-playback-speed-options-last-edit-timestamps.html |access-date=7 November 2024 |website=www.fonearena.com}}</ref>

Telegram introduced affiliate programs in December 2024 that allow developers to create an affiliate program for their bot or mini app. Any Telegram user can join the affiliate program and be rewarded for referring others to the bot or mini app by receiving a commission from purchases made by the people they referred.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Vasile |first=Cosmin |date=6 December 2024 |title=Telegram launches referral program for mini app creators, improved sticker search |url=https://www.phonearena.com/news/telegram-affiliate-programs-sticker-search-collages_id165591 |access-date=18 December 2024 |website=PhoneArena |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Stickers, emoji, reactions and effects ===
Telegram has more than 40,000 [[sticker (messaging)|sticker]]s. Stickers are cloud-based, high-resolution images intended to provide more expressive [[emoji]]. When typing in an emoji, the user is offered to send the respective sticker instead. Stickers come in collections called "packs", and multiple stickers can be offered for one emoji. Telegram comes with one default sticker pack,<ref name="Telegram Stickers">{{cite web|url=https://telegram.org/blog/stickers-meet-art-and-history|publisher=Telegram|title=Telegram Stickers|date=2 January 2015|access-date=5 January 2016|archive-date=6 August 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190806091723/https://telegram.org/blog/stickers-meet-art-and-history|url-status=live}}</ref> and users can install additional sticker packs provided by third-party contributors.

Sticker sets installed from one client become automatically available to all other clients. Sticker images use [[WebP]] file format, which is better optimized to be transmitted over the internet. The Telegram clients also support animated emoji.<ref name=":2" /> In January 2022, video stickers were added, which use the [[WebM]] file format and do not feature any software requirements to create.<ref name="XDAVideoStickers" />

In August 2019, Telegram introduced animated emoji,<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Evolution of Telegram |url=https://telegram.org/evolution#august-2019 |access-date=3 June 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref> larger versions of familiar emoji with unique animations. In September 2021, Telegram added interactive emoji, a type of animated emoji which also play a fullscreen effect in the chat.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Evolution of Telegram |url=https://telegram.org/evolution#september-2021 |access-date=3 June 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref> These kinds of effects were later used for Premium Stickers in June 2022<ref name="auto3">{{Cite web |title=The Evolution of Telegram |url=https://telegram.org/evolution#june-2022 |access-date=3 June 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref> and for message effects in May 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |date=31 May 2024 |title=Message Effects, Hashtag Search, and More |url=https://telegram.org/blog/message-effects-and-more |access-date=3 June 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref>

In August 2022, Telegram launched an emoji platform where users could upload their own custom emoji, either in animated or static versions.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Evolution of Telegram |url=https://telegram.org/evolution#august-2022 |access-date=3 June 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref> While any user can upload custom emoji to the platform, the use of custom emoji in chats is only available to users with Telegram Premium.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Olukotun |first=Oluwasegun |title=Telegram introduces its Emoji Platform, rolls out Custom Animated Emoji Packs, Gifting Telegram Premium, and More |url=https://innovation-village.com/telegram-introduces-its-emoji-platform-rolls-out-custom-animated-emoji-packs-gifting-telegram-premium-and-more/ |access-date=3 June 2024 |website=innovation-village.com|date=16 August 2022 }}</ref>

Reactions were first added to Telegram in 2021<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Evolution of Telegram |url=https://telegram.org/evolution#december-2021-second-update |access-date=3 June 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref> and expanded to include more emoji options for Premium users.<ref name="auto3"/> In September 2022, Telegram gave free users access to dozens of reactions, even some that were only previously available to Premium subscribers. To accommodate the new reactions, the reaction panel was expanded and redesigned.<ref name="xda-developers.com" />

=== People Nearby and Groups Near Me ===
People Nearby and Groups Near Me were features that helped users contact people in their physical vicinity, using their phone's [[GPS]] location.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://techcrunch.com/2019/06/25/telegram-adds-location-flavored-extras-and-full-group-ownership-transfers/ |title=Telegram adds location-flavored extras and full group ownership transfers |date=25 June 2019 |website=TechCrunch |access-date=3 June 2021 |archive-date=3 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210603124745/https://techcrunch.com/2019/06/25/telegram-adds-location-flavored-extras-and-full-group-ownership-transfers/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url = https://telegram.org/blog/protected-content-delete-by-date-and-more|title = Protected Content, Delete by Date, Device Management and More|date = 7 December 2021|access-date = 8 December 2021|archive-date = 8 December 2021|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20211208180925/https://telegram.org/blog/protected-content-delete-by-date-and-more|url-status = live}}</ref> They were removed in 2024, with Durov saying that they had had "issues with bots and scammers".<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Milmo |first1=Dan |last2=Sauer |first2=Pjotr |date=6 September 2024 |title=Telegram to drop 'people nearby' feature and improve moderation |url=https://www.theguardian.com/technology/article/2024/sep/06/telegram-to-drop-people-nearby-feature-and-improve-moderation |access-date=7 September 2024 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref>

=== Stories ===
Similar to other social platforms, Telegram users can post [[Story (social media)|stories]], a type of short-form content. Telegram stories have several distinctive features, like a dual-camera mode, extra privacy settings, the ability to edit stories after posting them, as well as to rewind and fast-forward them while watching.<ref>{{Cite web |date=15 August 2023 |title=Telegram stories are finally available to everyone |url=https://www.androidpolice.com/telegram-10-update-stories-available/ |access-date=21 August 2023 |website=Android Police |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Malik |first=Aisha |date=14 August 2023 |title=Telegram rolls out its Stories feature to all users |url=https://techcrunch.com/2023/08/14/telegram-rolls-out-its-stories-feature-to-all-users/ |access-date=21 August 2023 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Telegram: Telegram rolls out new features with Halloween update: Replies 2.0, adjustable link previews and more |url=https://www.gadgetsnow.com/apps/telegram-rolls-out-new-features-with-halloween-update-replies-2-0-adjustable-link-previews-and-more/articleshow/104832900.cms |access-date=31 October 2023 |website=Gadgets Now |language=en}}</ref>

=== Premium features ===
Telegram Premium was launched on 19 June 2022 with regional pricing.<ref name="700M_premium" /><ref name=":4" /> The optional paid subscription gives users increased limits in the app, such as larger file uploads, faster download speeds, unlimited voice message transcription,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Weatherbed |first=Jess |date=1 December 2023 |title=Telegram opens up voice transcription to all users in latest update |url=https://www.theverge.com/2023/12/1/23983851/telegram-update-voice-transcription-similar-channels-feature |access-date=17 December 2023 |website=The Verge |language=en}}</ref> as well as numerous other increases such as the number of pinned chats and folders. Premium users have access to extra stickers, emoji, reactions, and customization features like a special badge and the ability to change the look of their messages in chats. Premium users get access to additional settings, like instant chat translation, and the ability to restrict who can send them text and voice messages.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Singh |first=Manish |date=19 June 2022 |title=Telegram launches premium tier as it tops 700 million users |url=https://techcrunch.com/2022/06/19/telegram-tops-700-million-users-launches-premium-tier/ |access-date=5 December 2023 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="700M_premium" />

As of 2023, Telegram Premium can be acquired via in-app purchases facilitated by Apple and Google, directly via Telegram's @PremiumBot, or with cryptocurrency on the Fragment platform.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 August 2023 |title=What is Telegram Premium and should you upgrade? |url=https://www.androidauthority.com/telegram-premium-price-features-availability-3177921/ |access-date=5 December 2023 |website=Android Authority |language=en}}</ref> Users are able to purchase a subscription for themselves, or purchase a subscription for someone else to send as a gift. Premium subscriptions can also be won through official Channel Giveaways, in which Telegram channels pre-purchase a specific number of Premium subscriptions that are randomly given away to their subscribers.<ref name="PhoneArenaGiveaways" />

=== Gifts ===
In October 2024, Telegram launched Gifts,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Telegram launches new 'Gifts' feature with NFT integration {{!}} Telegram {{!}} CryptoRank.io |url=https://cryptorank.io/news/feed/ef676-telegram-launches-new-gifts-feature |access-date=2025-10-27 |website=CryptoRank |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-05 |title=Gifts, Verification Platform and More |url=https://telegram.org/blog/gifts-verification-platform |access-date=2025-10-27 |website=Telegram}}</ref> a type of virtual cosmetic item that users can purchase and send to each other in the app using Telegram Stars. In January 2025, Collectible Gifts<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-01-01 |title=Collectible Gifts, Message Search Filters and More |url=https://telegram.org/blog/collectible-gifts-and-more |access-date=2025-10-27 |website=Telegram}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Hitchcock |first=Logan |date=2025-01-03 |title=Telegram Will Let Users Convert Digital Gifts Into Tradable TON NFTs |url=https://decrypt.co/299477/telegram-convert-digital-gifts-ton-nfts |access-date=2025-10-27 |website=Decrypt |language=en-US}}</ref> were released, which are unique collections that contain special artwork and attributes. Specific limited-edition gifts can be upgraded to a collectible version, unlocking a random appearance and other attributes. These collectible gifts are registered on the [[TON (blockchain)|TON blockchain]] as a form of [[Non-fungible token|NFT]] and can then be traded or sold both on the Telegram platform via the in-app Gift Marketplace<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-08 |title=Gift Marketplace, Posting Several Stories at Once, Auto-Translate For Channels |url=https://telegram.org/blog/gift-marketplace-and-more |access-date=2025-10-27 |website=Telegram}}</ref> or via outside platforms and marketplaces.

In July 2025, Telegram partnered with the rapper and media figure Snoop Dogg to release a set of limited edition collectible gifts alongside his music video ''"Gifts"''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=JoVonn |first=Jeroslyn |date=2025-07-11 |title=Snoop Dogg's NFT Gift Launch In Partnership With Telegram Sold Out In Minutes |url=https://www.blackenterprise.com/snoop-dogg-nft-digital-gifts-telegram/ |access-date=2025-10-27 |website=Black Enterprise |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sknGyx2vRg4 |title=Snoop Dogg - Gifts (Official Music Video) |date=2025-07-09 |author=SnoopDoggTV |access-date=2025-10-27 |via=YouTube}}</ref> In November 2025, Telegram began using an auction-based system for new sets of collectible gifts and partnered with [[Khabib Nurmagomedov]] and with the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] for two limited-edition releases.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-24 |title=Pavel Durov, together with Khabib Nurmagomedov, will present a new auction |url=https://zamin.uz/en/world/171508-pavel-durov-together-with-khabib-nurmagomedov-will-present-a-new-auction.html |access-date=2025-12-08 |website=Zamin |language=en}}</ref>

== Related platforms ==
[[File:Telegra.ph example article editing.png|thumb|Telegraph article]]
People can use their Telegram accounts to author articles on Telegraph – a minimalistic text editor and publisher.
