While articles on Telegraph can be published anonymously, tying them to one's account allows one to check their view count and edit them later. Telegraph natively supports Instant View, a feature which lets users read full articles in the chat with no load time and without opening an external browser.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web |date=23 November 2016 |title= Secure messaging app Telegram now offers its own anonymous blogging platform |url= https://techcrunch.com/2016/11/22/telegram-telegraph/ |url-status= live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210525092951/https://techcrunch.com/2016/11/22/telegram-telegraph/ |archive-date=25 May 2021 |access-date= 25 May 2021 |work=TechCrunch}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=10 December 2018 |title=Custom Languages, Instant View 2.0 and More |url= https://telegram.org/blog/translations-iv2 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209081856/https://telegram.org/blog/translations-iv2 |archive-date=9 December 2020 |access-date=16 August 2020 | publisher =Telegram}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Instant View |url= https://instantview.telegram.org/ |url-status= live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209081927/https://instantview.telegram.org/ |archive-date= 9 December 2020 |access-date=16 August 2020 | publisher = Telegram}}</ref>

When an article is first published, the URL is generated automatically from its title. Non-Latin characters are transliterated, spaces are replaced with hyphens, and the date of publication is added to the address. For example, an article titled "Telegraph (blog platform)" published on 17 November would receive the URL <code>/Telegraph-blog-platform-11-17</code>.<ref name="auto" />

Text formatting options are also minimal: two levels of headings, single-level lists, bold, italics, quotes, and hyperlinks are supported. Authors could upload images and videos to the page, with a limit of 5 [[Megabyte|MB]], however, it has been disabled since September 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Du Rove's Channel |url=https://t.me/durov/343 |access-date=5 October 2024 |website=Telegram}}</ref> When an author adds links to YouTube, Vimeo, or Twitter, the service allows you to embed their content directly in the article.<ref>{{Cite web |date=22 November 2016 |title=Telegram launches Telegraph, a long-form publishing platform |url= https://venturebeat.com/2016/11/22/telegram-launches-telegraph-a-long-form-publishing-platform/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209084752/https://venturebeat.com/2016/11/22/telegram-launches-telegraph-a-long-form-publishing-platform/ |archive-date=9 December 2020 |access-date=5 December 2020 |website=VentureBeat |language=en-US}}</ref>

In February 2018, Telegram launched their [[social login]] feature to its users, named Telegram Login. It features a website widget that could be embedded into websites, allowing users to sign into a third party website with their Telegram account. The gateway sends users' Telegram name, username, and profile picture to the website owner, while users' phone number remains hidden. The gateway is integrated with a bot, which is linked with the developer's specific website domain.<ref name="Neowin48" />

In July 2018, Telegram introduced their online authorization and [[identity-management system]], Telegram Passport, for platforms that require real-life identification.<ref>{{cite web |date=26 July 2018 |title=Introducing Telegram Passport |url=https://telegram.org/blog/passport |url-status= live |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20201209121831/https://telegram.org/blog/passport |archive-date=9 December 2020 |access-date=4 August 2018 | publisher = Telegram}}</ref> It asks users to upload their own official documents such as passport, identity card, driver license, etc. When an online service requires such identification documents and verification, it forwards the information to the platform with the user's permission. Telegram stated that it does not have access to the data, while the platform will share the information only with the authorized recipient.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Telegram Passport stores your real-world IDs in the cloud |language=en-US |work=Engadget |url=https://www.engadget.com/2018/07/27/telegram-passport/ |url-status=live |access-date=4 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190724110556/https://www.engadget.com/2018/07/27/telegram-passport/ |archive-date= 24 July 2019}}</ref> However, the service was criticised for being vulnerable to online [[brute-force attack]]s.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Canellis |first= David |date= 2 August 2018 |title=Telegram Passport is already drawing fire for not being secure enough |language=en-US | work = The Next Web |url= https://thenextweb.com/hardfork/2018/08/02/telegram-passport-passwords-crack/ |url-status=live |access-date=4 August 2018 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20201209121912/https://thenextweb.com/hardfork/2018/08/02/telegram-passport-passwords-crack/ |archive-date=9 December 2020}}</ref>

In December 2020, Telegram launched a Bugs and Suggestions platform,<ref>{{Cite web | title=Telegram messenger launches voice chat for groups, to introduce premium features next year |url=https://telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/telegram-messenger-launches-voice-chat-for-groups-to-introduce-premium-features-next-year/79936124 |access-date=17 June 2023 |website=ETTelecom | via = India Times}}</ref> where users can submit bug reports and suggestion cards for new features. Others can then vote and comment on the cards.

In October 2024, Telegram launched a verification platform, called Telegram Gateway, allowing third-party services to authenticate their users by sending verification codes via Telegram.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Morales |first=James |date=15 October 2024 |title=Pavel Durov Introduces Telegram Phone Verification Service, Calls Price 'Unprecedentedly Low' |url=https://www.ccn.com/news/technology/pavel-durov-telegram-gateway-phone-verification/ |access-date=21 October 2024 |website=CCN}}</ref>

== Architecture ==

=== Privacy ===
[[File:Explanation of secret chats (Telegram).png|thumb|300px|A simplified illustration of the MTProto encryption scheme]]
For encrypted chats (branded as Secret Chats), Telegram uses a custom-built [[symmetric encryption]] scheme called MTProto. The protocol was developed by [[Nikolai Durov]] and other developers at Telegram and, as of version 2.0, is based on 256-bit symmetric [[Advanced Encryption Standard|AES]] encryption, 2048-bit [[RSA (cryptosystem)|RSA]] encryption and [[Diffie–Hellman key exchange]].<ref name="techfaq">{{cite web|url = https://core.telegram.org/techfaq|title = FAQ for the Technically Inclined|website = Telegram|access-date = 9 January 2016|archive-date = 28 January 2017|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20170128144833/https://core.telegram.org/techfaq|url-status = live}}</ref><ref name=":15">{{Cite arXiv |last1=Miculan |first1=Marino |last2=Vitacolonna |first2=Nicola |date=5 December 2020 |title=Automated Symbolic Verification of Telegram's MTProto 2.0 |class=cs.CR |eprint=2012.03141v1 }}</ref>

MTProto 1.0 was deprecated in favor of MTProto 2.0 in December 2017, which was deployed in Telegram clients as of v4.6.<ref name=":15" />

Version 2.0 was [[Zero-knowledge proof|proven formally correct]] in December 2020 by a team from the [[University of Udine|University of Udine, Italy]]. The team reviewed the protocol after realizing that they could only find in-depth verifications done of version 1.0, where most criticisms were levied. They used [[ProVerif]], a verifier based on the [[Symbolic model checking|symbolic]] [[Dolev–Yao model|Dolev-Yao model]]. In the published paper, they "provide a fully automated proof of the soundness of MTProto 2.0’s protocols for authentication, normal chat, end-to-end encrypted chat, and re-keying mechanisms with respect to several security properties, including authentication, integrity, confidentiality and perfect forward secrecy...MTProto 2.0 is assumed to be a perfect authenticated encryption scheme ([[Ciphertext indistinguishability|IND-CCA]] and INT-CTXT)."<ref name=":15" /><ref name=":16">{{cite journal |last1=Miculan |first1=Marino |last2=Vitacolonna |first2=Nicola |title=Automated verification of Telegram's MTProto 2.0 in the symbolic model |journal=Computers & Security |date=March 2023 |volume=126 |article-number=103072 |doi=10.1016/j.cose.2022.103072}}</ref>

However, the team also stated that because all communication, including plaintext and ciphertext, passes through Telegram servers, and because the server is responsible for choosing Diffie–Hellman parameters, the "server should not be considered as trusted." They also concluded that a [[man-in-the-middle attack]] is possible if users fail to check the [[Fingerprint (computing)|fingerprints]] of their shared [[Key (cryptography)|keys]]. Finally, they qualified their conclusion with the caveat that "properties need to be formally proved in order to deem MTProto 2.0 definitely secure. This proof cannot be done in a symbolic model like ProVerif's, but it can be achieved in a computational model, using tools like [[CryptoVerif]] or EasyCrypt."{{Citation needed|date=August 2026}}

=== Servers ===
As with most instant messaging protocols, apart from [[XMPP]], Telegram uses [[Centralized computing|centralized]] servers. Telegram Messenger LLP has servers in a number of countries throughout the world to improve the response time of their service.<ref>{{cite web|trans-title=Telegram, the chat that competes with WhatsApp|place=[[Uruguay|UY]]|url=http://www.elpais.com.uy/vida-actual/que-telegram-chat-que-compite.html|work=El País|title=Telegram, el chat que compite con Whatsapp|language=es|access-date=8 January 2016|archive-date=8 February 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140208163824/http://www.elpais.com.uy/vida-actual/que-telegram-chat-que-compite.html|url-status=live}}</ref> Telegram's server-side software is closed-source and proprietary.<ref name=faq-why-not-open-souce>{{Cite web|title=Telegram FAQ|url=https://telegram.org/faq#q-can-i-get-telegram-39s-server-side-code|access-date=29 March 2021|website=Telegram|archive-date=9 February 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140209082001/https://telegram.org/faq#q-can-i-get-telegram-39s-server-side-code|url-status=live}}</ref> Pavel Durov said that it would require a major architectural redesign of the server-side software to connect independent servers to the Telegram cloud.<ref>{{cite web|title = Pavel Durov, creador de Telegram: "Ninguna aplicación es 100% segura"|url = http://www.eldiario.es/turing/moviles_y_tabletas/telegram-pavel_durov-entrevista-app-movil-seguridad_0_224677688.html|work = eldiario.es|date = 2 February 2014|access-date = 12 February 2014|trans-title = Pavel Durov, creator of Telegram: "No application is 100% safe"|last = Rull|first = Antonio|language = es|archive-date = 8 February 2014|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20140208003046/http://www.eldiario.es/turing/moviles_y_tabletas/telegram-pavel_durov-entrevista-app-movil-seguridad_0_224677688.html|url-status = live}}</ref>

For users who signed in from the [[European Economic Area]] (EEA) or United Kingdom, the [[General Data Protection Regulation]]s (GDPR) are supported by storing data only on servers in the Netherlands, and designating a [[London]]-based company as their responsible data controller.<ref name=lexology-20200129>{{cite web |url=https://www.lexology.com/library/detail.aspx?g=066cf923-6cb5-49d9-b0c7-2c433ba521ea |title=GDPR vs US Discovery: US Court Makes Clear Non-US Entities Can't Avoid Discovery |publisher=Law Business Research |work=Linklaters LLP |date=29 January 2020 |access-date=19 June 2020 |archive-date=21 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200621042801/https://www.lexology.com/library/detail.aspx?g=066cf923-6cb5-49d9-b0c7-2c433ba521ea |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=telegram-storingdata>{{cite web |url=https://telegram.org/privacy#4-1-storing-data |title=Telegram Privacy Policy – Storing Data |publisher=Telegram |access-date=19 June 2020 |archive-date=8 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150908095619/https://telegram.org/privacy#4-1-storing-data |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=telegram-eea>{{cite web |url=https://telegram.org/privacy#1-4-eea-representative |title=Telegram Privacy Policy – EEA Representative |publisher=Telegram |access-date=19 June 2020 |archive-date=8 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150908095619/https://telegram.org/privacy#1-4-eea-representative |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== Clients ===
Telegram has various client apps, some developed by Telegram Messenger LLP and some by the community. Most of them are [[free and open-source]] and released under the [[GNU General Public License|GNU General Public Licence]] {{Nowrap|version 2}} or 3. The official clients support sending any file format extensions. The built-in media viewer supports common media formats – JPEG, PNG, WebP for images and H.264 and HEVC in videos in MP4 container and MP3, FLAC, Vorbis, Opus and AAC for audio. This enables the building of clients for non-traditional platforms like [[KaiOS]] (supported by Telekram),<ref>{{Citation |work=Cyan |title=cyan-2048/solid-telekram |date=2025-06-24 |url=https://github.com/cyan-2048/solid-telekram |access-date=2025-07-22}}</ref> or [[Series 30+|S30+]]/Mocor Feature phones (still in development).

In 2021, the Telegram team announced a direct build of its Android app. Telegram for Android is available directly from the Telegram website.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Telegram for Android|url=https://telegram.org/android|access-date=17 June 2021|website=Telegram|archive-date=14 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210614012044/https://telegram.org/android|url-status=live}}</ref> It is automatically updated and will most likely get new versions faster than the apps in the Play Store and App Store.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Telegram Tips|url=https://t.me/TelegramTips/275|access-date=17 June 2021|website=Telegram|archive-date=24 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210624200141/https://t.me/TelegramTips/275|url-status=live}}</ref> A distinctive feature of this version is the ability to view channels/groups on a specific topic without censorship, which cannot be viewed from an app distributed from Google Play or the Apple Store due to their policies.{{Citation needed|date=June 2021}}

'''Common specifications:'''

* No cloud backup option for secret chat

=== APIs ===
Telegram has public [[Application programming interface|APIs]] with which developers can access the same functionality as Telegram's official apps to build their own instant messaging applications.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.programmableweb.com/news/can-telegram-beat-whatsapp-public-api/2014/03/03|title=Can Telegram Beat WhatsApp with a Public API?|last=Roble|first=Patricio|date=3 March 2014|work=ProgrammableWeb|access-date=17 March 2016|archive-date=12 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512230512/https://www.programmableweb.com/news/can-telegram-beat-whatsapp-public-api/2014/03/03|url-status=live}}</ref> In February 2015, creators of the unofficial WhatsApp+ client released the Telegram Plus app, later renamed to Plus Messenger, after their original project got a [[Cease and desist|cease-and-desist order]] from [[WhatsApp]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.androidpolice.com/2015/02/27/whatsapp-developer-releases-telegram-forced-drop-first-project/|title=WhatsApp+ Developer Releases Telegram+ After Being Forced To Drop The First Project|last=King|first=Bertel|date=27 February 2015|work=AndroidPolice|access-date=17 March 2016|archive-date=12 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512230458/https://www.androidpolice.com/2015/02/27/whatsapp-developer-releases-telegram-forced-drop-first-project/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.androidpolice.com/2015/01/21/whatsapp-now-officially-dead-receiving-cease-desist-real-whatsapp/|title=WhatsApp+ Is Now Officially Dead After Receiving A Cease And Desist From The Real WhatsApp|date=21 January 2015|website=Android Police|access-date=17 March 2016|archive-date=12 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512230511/https://www.androidpolice.com/2015/01/21/whatsapp-now-officially-dead-receiving-cease-desist-real-whatsapp/|url-status=live}}</ref> In September 2015, [[Samsung]] released a messaging application based on these APIs.<ref>{{cite web|url = http://news.samsung.com/global/socializer-messenger-app-offers-a-new-approach-to-messaging|title = Socializer Messenger App Offers a New Approach to Messaging|date = 14 September 2015|access-date = 3 January 2016|archive-date = 12 May 2019|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190512230453/https://news.samsung.com/global/socializer-messenger-app-offers-a-new-approach-to-messaging|url-status = live}}</ref>

Telegram also offers an API that allows developers to create [[IM bot|bots]], which are accounts controlled by programs.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.programmableweb.com/news/telegram-launches-bot-api-and-platform/2015/06/29|title=Telegram Launches Bot API and Platform|last=Carter|first=Eric|date=27 June 2015|website=ProgrammableWeb|access-date=February 17, 2026|archive-date=12 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512230507/https://www.programmableweb.com/news/telegram-launches-bot-api-and-platform/2015/06/29|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2015/06/24/telegrams-new-platform-lets-developers-create-smart-message-bots-with-multiple-uses/|title=Telegram's New Platform Lets Developers Create Smart Message Bots With Multiple Uses|last=Butcher|first=Mike|date=24 June 2015|website=TechCrunch|access-date=15 September 2017|archive-date=3 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190503201134/https://techcrunch.com/2015/06/24/telegrams-new-platform-lets-developers-create-smart-message-bots-with-multiple-uses/|url-status=live}}</ref> Such bots are used, among other things, to emulate and play old games in the app and inform users about vaccine availability for [[COVID-19]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://jilaxzone.com/2021/03/12/theres-retro-game-emulator-hiding-inside-telegram-messenger-heres-how-to-use-it-android-iphone/ |title=There's retro-game emulator hiding inside Telegram Messenger. Here's how to use it |author=Jonathan |date=12 March 2021 |website=Jilaxzone |access-date=14 May 2021 |archive-date=14 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210514230822/https://jilaxzone.com/2021/03/12/theres-retro-game-emulator-hiding-inside-telegram-messenger-heres-how-to-use-it-android-iphone/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/eligible-but-struggling-to-get-a-covid-19-vaccine-appointment-here-are-some-tips/2506408/ |title=Eligible But Struggling to Get a COVID-19 Vaccine Appointment? Here Are Some Tips |last=Budman |first=Scott |date=30 March 2021 |website=NBC Bay Area |access-date=14 May 2021 |archive-date=14 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210514230822/https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/eligible-but-struggling-to-get-a-covid-19-vaccine-appointment-here-are-some-tips/2506408/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

In addition, Telegram offers functions for making payments directly within the platform, alongside an external service such as [[Stripe (company)|Stripe]].{{Citation needed|date=August 2026}}

==AI features==
In 2026, Telegram began to include generative AI features in its app, which use open-source models running in Telegram's [[Confidential computing|confidential compute]] network, Cocoon. In January 2026, AI summaries were introduced, which allow users to summarize long posts in channels or the text of articles that support Instant View. In March 2026, Telegram launched an AI text editor, where users can use AI to translate or stylize their message text.{{Citation needed|date=August 2026}}

In 2025, Durov announced an agreement with xAI to bring AI features to the Telegram app,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Capoot |first=Ashley |date=2025-05-28 |title=Telegram CEO announces $300 million partnership with Elon Musk's xAI and Grok |url=https://www.cnbc.com/2025/05/28/elon-musk-xai-telegram-grok.html |access-date=2026-04-07 |website=CNBC |language=en}}</ref> but the partnership never materialized. According to media reports, Telegram backed away from third-party partnerships with existing AI companies to prioritize user privacy,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-29 |title=Exclusive: why the Telegram–Grok integration announced in 2025 never materialized |url=https://durovscode.com/why-telegram-grok-no-deal |access-date=2026-04-07 |website=Durov˙s Code |language=en}}</ref> ultimately leading to the development and launch of Cocoon.

== Business ==
Telegram was initially supported by founding CEO Pavel Durov's personal funds after the sale of his stake in VK. In January 2018, it launched a private placement and collected $1.7 billion from investors such as [[Kleiner Perkins]], [[Sequoia Capital]], and [[Benchmark (venture capital firm)|Benchmark]].<ref>{{cite news |first1=Chloe |last1=Cornish |first2=Richard |last2=Waters |title=Silicon Valley investors line up to back Telegram ICO |url=https://www.ft.com/content/790d9506-0175-11e8-9650-9c0ad2d7c5b5 |website=Financial Times |date=25 January 2018 |access-date=28 September 2021 |url-access=subscription |archive-date=28 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210928082709/https://www.ft.com/content/790d9506-0175-11e8-9650-9c0ad2d7c5b5 |url-status=live }}</ref> After the shutdown of the [[Telegram Open Network|TON]] project, the company needed to repay the investors the money that was not spent on its development during 2018 and the beginning of 2019, while the project was active.<ref name="Schechner">{{Cite news |last=Schechner |first=Sam |date=15 March 2021 |title=Telegram App Is Booming but Needs Advertisers—and $700 Million Soon |language=en-US |work=[[The Wall Street Journal]] |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/telegram-app-is-booming-but-needs-advertisersand-700-million-soon-11615806001 |access-date=16 March 2021 |issn=0099-9660 |archive-date=16 March 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210316153024/https://www.wsj.com/articles/telegram-app-is-booming-but-needs-advertisersand-700-million-soon-11615806001 |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 15 March 2021, Telegram conducted a five-year public bonds placement worth $1 billion. The funding was required to cover the debts amounting to $625.7 million, including $433 million to investors who bought futures for Gram tokens in 2018 and included purchasers such as [[David Yakobashvili]].<ref name="Telegram разместил бонды на $1 млрд">{{cite web |url=https://www.rbc.ru/finances/15/03/2021/604f11019a794780341309c9 |title=Telegram разместил бонды на $1 млрд. На каких условиях инвесторы рискнули вложиться во внебиржевые бумаги |author1=Павел Казарновский|author2=Владислав Скобелев|author3=Анна Балашова |date=15 March 2021 |publisher=RBC |access-date=15 March 2021 |archive-date=15 March 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210315144542/https://www.rbc.ru/finances/15/03/2021/604f11019a794780341309c9 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 23 March, Telegram sold additional bonds worth $150 million to the Abu Dhabi [[Mubadala Investment Company]] and Abu Dhabi Catalyst Partners.<ref name="TC On Bonds">{{cite web|author=Natasha Lomas|date=23 March 2021|title=Telegram raises $150M from Mubadala and Abu Dhabi CP via pre-IPO convertible bonds|url=https://techcrunch.com/2021/03/23/telegram-raises-150m-from-mubadala-and-abu-dhabi-cp-via-pre-ipo-convertible-bonds/|access-date=23 March 2021|publisher=TechCrunch|archive-date=23 March 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210323132059/https://techcrunch.com/2021/03/23/telegram-raises-150m-from-mubadala-and-abu-dhabi-cp-via-pre-ipo-convertible-bonds/|url-status=live}}</ref> In March 2026, Durov announced that Telegram had fully repaid the bonds issued in 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Pavel Durov |url=https://t.me/durov/476 |access-date=2026-03-25 |website=Telegram}}</ref>

A day later, the Mubadala Investment Company stated that Russia's [[Russian Direct Investment Fund|sovereign wealth fund]] participated in its deal undisclosed through the Russia-[[UAE]] joint investment platform to buy convertible bonds. A Telegram spokesperson stated: "RDIF is not in the list of investors we sold bonds to. We wouldn't be open to any transaction with this fund" and "[t]he funds that did invest, including Mubadala, confirmed to us that RDIF was not among their LPs [''limited partners'']."<ref>{{cite web|author=Jake Rudnitsky, Zainab Fattah|date=23 March 2021|title=Mubadala Says It Brought RDIF Into Telegram Bond Stake|url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/russia-mubadala-invest-in-telegram-after-kremlin-ban-failed|access-date=3 April 2021|publisher=Bloomberg|archive-date=25 March 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210325050817/https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/russia-mubadala-invest-in-telegram-after-kremlin-ban-failed|url-status=live}}</ref> According to the contract, the holders of the bonds will be provided with an option to convert them to shares at a 10% discount if the company conducts an open IPO.<ref name="Schechner" />

Durov stated that the move aimed to "enable Telegram to continue growing globally while sticking to its values and remaining independent". According to press reports, prior to the bonds placement, Durov had rejected an investment offer for a 5–10% stake in the company as well as several undisclosed ones, valuing the company in a $30–40 billion range.<ref name="TC On Bonds" /> In March 2024, Telegram sold an additional $330 million in bonds. Durov said the bond sale "will further solidify our position as an independent platform that is able to challenge the 'Goliaths' of our industry".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/telegram-secures-330-million-bond-sales-2024-03-18/|title=Telegram secures $330 million in bond sales|author=Harshita Mary Varghese|date=18 March 2024|publisher=Reuters|access-date=18 March 2024}}</ref>

=== Advertising and monetization ===
Telegram has stated that the company will never serve advertisements in private chats.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://dollarsandsense.sg/how-whatsapp-telegram-snapchat-make-money-why-you-should-care/ |title=How Does WhatsApp, Telegram And Snapchat Make Money? (And Why You Should Care) |author=Tao Ming Hui |date=16 November 2017 |publisher=Dollars and Sense |access-date=10 March 2021 |archive-date=13 September 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190913105808/http://dollarsandsense.sg/how-whatsapp-telegram-snapchat-make-money-why-you-should-care/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In late 2020, Durov announced that the company was working on its own ad platform, and would integrate non-targeted ads in public one-to-many channels, that already were selling and displaying ads in the form of regular messages.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2020/12/23/telegram-to-launch-an-ad-platform-as-it-approaches-500-million-users/|title=Telegram, nearing 500 million users, to begin monetizing the app|date=23 December 2020 |access-date=20 January 2021|archive-date=27 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210627152101/https://techcrunch.com/2020/12/23/telegram-to-launch-an-ad-platform-as-it-approaches-500-million-users/|url-status=live|website=TechCrunch}}</ref> Ads from Telegram's "Sponsored Messages" platform began to appear in channels with more than 1000 followers in October 2021.{{Citation needed|date=August 2026}}

In late 2020, Durov announced that Telegram will consider adding paid features aimed at enterprise clients. According to him, these features will require more bandwidth and the added cost will be covered by the feature prices, in addition to covering some of the costs incurred by regular users.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://gadgets.ndtv.com/apps/news/telegram-private-messaging-app-500-million-users-premium-subscription-2021-pavel-durov-2342668|title= Telegram to Launch Paid Features for Business and Power Users in 2021 |work= NDTV Gadgets 360 |date=23 December 2020 |access-date=31 May 2021}}</ref>

In June 2024, Telegram launched Telegram Stars to facilitate in-app purchases of digital goods and services, in compliance with policies from the App Store and Play Store.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-06 |title=Telegram Stars: Pay for Digital Goods and More |url=https://telegram.org/blog/telegram-stars#ready-for-app-stores |access-date=2025-01-10 |website=Telegram}}</ref> Following the launch of Stars, Telegram released several updates to their functionality, such as allowing Stars to be used to unlock media in channels or to buy gifts for other users.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hearn |first=Patrick |date=2025-01-02 |title=Telegram's first update of 2025 adds NFTs and more message reactions |url=https://www.androidpolice.com/telegram-update-collectible-gifts-nfts-service-message-reactions/ |access-date=2025-01-10 |website=Android Police |language=en}}</ref>

In December 2024, Telegram CEO Pavel Durov announced that Telegram had reached profitability, due to significant growth in Premium subscriptions and Telegram ad sales, assisted by the other monetization features launched throughout 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mehta |first=Ivan |date=23 December 2024 |title=Pavel Durov says Telegram is now profitable |url=https://techcrunch.com/2024/12/23/pavel-durov-says-telegram-is-now-profitable/ |access-date=23 December 2024 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== TON Telegram Open Network ===
{{Main|The Open Network}}

In 2017, in an attempt to monetize Telegram without advertising, the company began the development of a [[blockchain]] platform dubbed either "The Open Network" or "[[Telegram Open Network]]" (TON) and its native [[cryptocurrency]] "Gram". The project was announced in mid-December 2017<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/technology/cryptic-russian-crusader-says-his-5-billion-app-can-t-be-bought |title=This $5 Billion Encrypted App Isn't for Sale at Any Price |author1=Stepan Kravchenko|author2=((Nour Al Ali))|author3=Ilya Khrennikov |date=11 December 2017 |publisher=Bloomberg |access-date=8 March 2021 |archive-date=27 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210627152101/https://www.bloombergquint.com/technology/cryptic-russian-crusader-says-his-5-billion-app-can-t-be-bought |url-status=live }}</ref> and its 132-page technical paper became available in January 2018.<ref name="auto1">{{cite web|url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ucUeKg_NiR8RxNAonb8Q55jZha03WC0O/view|title=TON.pdf|website=Google Docs|access-date=5 May 2018|archive-date=27 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180827165521/https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ucUeKg_NiR8RxNAonb8Q55jZha03WC0O/view|url-status=live}}</ref> The codebase behind TON was developed by Pavel Durov's brother [[Nikolai Durov]], the core developer of Telegram's MTProto protocol.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://coinpost.media/f/telegram-ton/ |title=Telegram TON (Telegram Open Network) |publisher=Coinpost |access-date=23 March 2021 |archive-date=3 March 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210303112734/https://coinpost.media/f/telegram-ton/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In January 2018, a 23-page white paper<ref name="auto1"/> and a detailed 132-page technical paper<ref name="auto1"/> for TON blockchain became available.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/telegram-privacy-focused-user-could-180800518.html |title=Telegram's Privacy-Focused User Base Could Become TON Blockchain's Killer App |date=10 January 2018 |publisher=Bitcoin Magazine |access-date=23 March 2021 |archive-date=27 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210627152102/https://sports.yahoo.com/telegram-privacy-focused-user-could-180800518.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

Durov planned to power TON with the existing Telegram user base, and turn it into the largest blockchain and a platform for apps and services akin to a decentralized [[WeChat]], [[Google Play]], and [[App Store]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://techcrunch.com/2018/01/08/telegram-open-network/ |title=Telegram plans multi-billion dollar ICO for chat cryptocurrency |author=Mike Butcher, Josh Konstine |date=8 January 2018 |publisher=TechCrunch |access-date=4 April 2020 |archive-date=23 November 2020 |date=15 January 2018 |publisher=TechCrunch |access-date=4 April 2020 |archive-date=3 April 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200403222412/https://techcrunch.com/2018/01/15/inside-telegrams-ambitious-1-2b-ico-to-create-the-next-ethereum/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Besides, the TON had the potential to become a decentralized alternative to [[Visa Inc.|Visa]] and [[MasterCard]] due to its ability to scale and support millions of transactions per second.<ref name=rbth>{{cite web |url=https://www.rbth.com/science-and-tech/331547-durov-vk-telegram-russia-networks |title=Telegram's Pavel Durov in court over his quest to revolutionize cryptocurrency |author=Josh Nadeau |date=15 name="cnews">{{cite web|url=http://www.cnews.ru/news/top/2018-04-02_pri_kakih_usloviyah_telegram_vernet_investoram|title=Under what conditions will Telegram return to investors the collected $ 2.55 billion|last1=Korolev|first1=Igor|date=2 April 2018|website=CNews|language=ru|access-date=12 October 2018|archive-date=23 November web|url=https://www.theverge.com/2018/4/1/17186004/telegram-presale-open-network-app-ico-cryptocurrency-ton|title=Telegram has raised a total of $1.7 billion from its two pre-ICO name="shen1">{{cite news|url=http://fortune.com/2018/03/30/bitcoin-price-telegram-ico-presale/|title=Even as Bitcoin Languishes, Telegram Raises $1.7 Billion Ahead of Largest ICO Ever|last1=Shen|first1=Lucinda|date=31 March 2018|access-date=31 March 2018|publisher=Fortune|archive-date=9 November news|url=https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2018/04/131248-telegram-files-new-form-d-with-sec-indicating-1-7-billion-will-be-raised/|title=Telegram Files New Form D with SEC Indicating $1.7 Billion will be Raised {{!}} Crowdfund Insider|date=2 April 2018|work=Crowdfund Insider|access-date=6 April 2018|language=en-US|archive-date=30 October No public [[Initial coin offering|offering]] took place.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/telegram-messaging-app-scraps-plans-for-public-coin-offering-1525281933?ns=prod/accounts-wsj|title=Telegram Messaging App Scraps Plans for Public Coin Offering|last=Vigna|first=Paul|date=2 May 2018|work=[[The Wall Street Journal]]|access-date=11 November 2018|language=en-US|archive-date=12 November 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181112021355/https://www.wsj.com/articles/telegram-messaging-app-scraps-plans-for-public-coin-offering-1525281933?ns=prod%2Faccounts-wsj|url-status=live}}</ref>

The development of TON took place in a completely isolated manner, and the release was postponed several times. The test network was launched in January 2019.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://thebell.io/en/despite-delay-durov-on-track-to-launch-his-cryptocurrency-in-march/ |title=Despite delay, Durov on track to launch his cryptocurrency in March |work=The Bell — Eng |date=23 January 2019 |publisher=The Bell |access-date=17 March 2021 |archive-date=13 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210213105104/https://thebell.io/en/despite-delay-durov-on-track-to-launch-his-cryptocurrency-in-march/ |url-status=live }}</ref> The launch of the TON main network was scheduled for 31 October.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.theverge.com/2019/8/27/20835987/telegram-gram-cryptocurrency-coin-october-31-deadline-ico |title=Telegram will launch its Gram cryptocurrency by October 31 or bust |author=Sean Hollister |date=27 August 2019 |publisher=The Verge |access-date=21 March 2021 |archive-date=8 November 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201108003953/https://www.theverge.com/2019/8/27/20835987/telegram-gram-cryptocurrency-coin-october-31-deadline-ico |url-status=live }}</ref> On 30 October, the [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] obtained a temporary restrictive order to prevent the distribution of Grams to initial purchasers; the regulator considered the legal scheme employed by Telegram as an unregistered securities offering with initial buyers acting as [[underwriters]].<ref name="NYLAW">{{cite web |url=https://www.nortonrosefulbright.com/-/media/files/nrf/nrfweb/knowledge-pdfs/a-telegram-to-safts-beware.pdf |title=Blockchain law. A "Telegram" to SAFTs: "Beware!" |author=Robert A. Schwinger |date=26 May 2020 |publisher=New York Law Journal |access-date=15 March 2021 |archive-date=27 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210627152102/https://www.nortonrosefulbright.com/-/media/files/nrf/nrfweb/knowledge-pdfs/a-telegram-to-safts-beware.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref>

The judge hearing the ''Telegram v. SEC case'', [[P. Kevin Castel]], ultimately agreed with the SEC's argument<ref>{{cite web|title=Cooley|url=https://www.cooley.com/news/insight/2020/2020-05-07-sec-v-telegram-key-takeaways-implications|website=www.cooley.com|access-date=13 May 2020|archive-date=24 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200824212924/https://www.cooley.com/news/insight/2020/2020-05-07-sec-v-telegram-key-takeaways-implications|url-status=live}}</ref> and kept the restrictions on Gram distribution in force. The ban applied to non-U.S.-based purchasers as well, because Telegram could not prevent the re-sale of Grams to U.S. citizens on a secondary market, as the anonymity of users was one of the key features of TON.<ref name=JDSUPRA>{{cite web |url=https://www.jdsupra.com/legalnews/is-there-life-for-safts-after-the-54728/ |title=Is There Life for SAFTs After the Telegram Case? |date=21 July 2020 |publisher=JD Supra |access-date=10 March 2021 |archive-date=7 September 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200907174839/https://www.jdsupra.com/legalnews/is-there-life-for-safts-after-the-54728/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=GreenbergTraurig>{{cite web |url=https://www.gtlaw.com/en/insights/2020/4/sec-v-telegram--a-groundbreaking-decision-in-cryptocurrency-enforcement |title=SEC v. Telegram: A Groundbreaking Decision in Cryptocurrency Enforcement? |author=David I. Miller, Charlie Berk |date=1 April 2020 |publisher=Greenberg Traurig |access-date=10 March 2021 |archive-date=17 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210117023653/https://www.gtlaw.com/en/insights/2020/4/sec-v-telegram--a-groundbreaking-decision-in-cryptocurrency-enforcement |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="NYLAW" /> Following that, Durov announced the end of Telegram's active involvement with TON. On 26 June, the judge approved the settlement between Telegram and SEC. The company agreed to pay an $18.5 million penalty and return $1.22 billion to Gram purchasers.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telegram to pay SEC fine of $18.5 million and return $1.2 billion to investors as it dissolves TON |url=https://techcrunch.com/2020/06/26/telegram-to-pay-sec-fine-of-18-5-million-and-return-1-2-billion-to-investors-as-it-dissolves-ton/ |access-date=28 June 2020 |publisher=Techcrunch |date=26 June 2020 |archive-date=27 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200627223615/https://techcrunch.com/2020/06/26/telegram-to-pay-sec-fine-of-18-5-million-and-return-1-2-billion-to-investors-as-it-dissolves-ton/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In March 2021, Telegram launched a bonds offering to cover the debt and fund further growth of the app.<ref name="Telegram разместил бонды на $1 млрд" /><ref name="Schechner" />

== Criticism ==
Because Telegram is both a private communication method and a social media-like platform with mass groups and channels, and because it has minimal content restrictions, with only calls to violence, illegal forms of pornography,<ref>{{Cite magazine |last= Loucaides |first= Darren |date= 8 February 2022 |title= How Telegram Became the Anti-Facebook |magazine= [[Wired (magazine)|Wired]] |url= https://www.wired.com/story/how-telegram-became-anti-facebook/ |access-date= 28 March 2022}}</ref> and scamming forbidden, organizations and large groups have used it for recruitment and spreading their agendas. It has been used to organize pro-democracy protests in Belarus,<ref>{{cite magazine |last1= Williams |first1= Sean |title= Belarus has torn up the protest rulebook. Everyone should listen |url= https://www.wired.co.uk/article/belarus-protests-telegram |magazine= Wired |access-date= 19 April 2024}}</ref> Russia,<ref>{{cite web |title= Russia internet freedom: Mass rally in Moscow against Telegram ban |url= https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43948618 |website= BBC |access-date= 19 April 2024 |date= 30 April 2018}}</ref> Hong Kong,<ref>{{cite web |last1= Schectman |first1= Joel |title= Exclusive: Messaging app Telegram moves to protect identity of Hong Kong protesters |url= https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-telegram-exclusive/exclusive-messaging-app-telegram-moves-to-protect-identity-of-hong-kong-protesters-idUSKCN1VK2NI |website= Reuters |date= 31 August 2019 |access-date= 19 April 2024}}</ref> and Iran,<ref>{{cite news |last2= Woo |first1= Sam |last1= Schechner |first2= Stu |title= Iranians Turn to Telegram App Amid Protests |url= https://www.wsj.com/articles/iranians-turn-to-telegram-app-amid-protests-1514919114 |website= Wall Street Journal| url-access= subscription}}</ref> and to disseminate state propaganda and violent rhetoric in oppressive regimes, promote extremist views, and digitalize services provided by government entities and private businesses.<ref>{{multiref2| {{cite web |title= Минфин запустил Телеграм-бот для упрощения процесса получения материальной помощи и пособия на ребенка |url= https://podrobno.uz/cat/obchestvo/minfin-zapustil-telegram-bot-dlya-uproshcheniya-protsessa-poluchenie-materialnoy-pomoshchi-i-posobiya/ |website= Podrobno.uz |access-date= 19 April 2024 |language= ru }}| {{cite web |title= SE "Medical Procurement of Ukraine" launched the Telegram chat-bot |url= |date= 27 April 2021 }}| {{cite web |last1= Mae Soco |first1= Rhea |title= Chatbot launched as part of 'back to school' campaign |url= https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50814827/chatbot-launched-as-part-of-back-to-school-campaign |website= Khmer Times |access-date= 19 April 2024 |date= 16 February 2021 }} |{{cite web |last1= Paul |first1= https://www.t13.cl/noticia/nacional/usuarios-del-transantiago-podran-saber-cuando-viene-su-bus-traves-facebook-y-telegram |website= www.t13.cl |date= 23 June 2017 |access-date= 19 April 2024 |language= es }}| {{cite web |publisher= Ministero della Salute |place= Italy |title= Covid-19, nasce il canale Telegram del ministero della Salute |url=
