https://web.archive.org/web/20240825105217/https://www.salute.gov.it/portale/news/p3_2_1_1_1.jsp?id=4479&lingua=italiano&menu=notizie&p=null |url-status= dead }}}}</ref>

Many research institutions and internet monitoring bodies have criticized Telegram because violent organizations like [[Islamic State|ISIS]], [[Proud Boys]],<ref>{{cite web|website=[[The New York Times]]|title=Proud Boys celebrate Trump's 'stand by' remark about them at the debate|date=29 September 2020|access-date=11 October 2020|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2020/09/29/us/trump-proud-boys-biden.html|archive-date=9 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209052024/https://www.nytimes.com/2020/09/29/us/trump-proud-boys-biden.html|url-status=live}}</ref> and the [[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar junta]] used it to communicate, both privately between members and publicly through channel posts. Telegram made substantial efforts<ref>{{cite web |title=Telegram says it has had to remove 'hundreds' of public calls for violence |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/telegram-capitol-riots-violence-messaging-apps-b1789603.html |website=The Independent |access-date=19 April 2024 |language=en |date=19 January 2021}}</ref><ref name="auto4">{{Cite web |url=https://www.crikey.com.au/2020/10/19/telegram-bans-350000-child-abusers-terrorists/|last=Ravlic |first=Tom |title=This dark world: messaging app bans more than 350,000 child abusers and terrorists |publisher=[[Crikey]]|date=19 October 2020}}</ref> to ban illegal content such as child abuse and pro-terrorist channels, including a partnership with Europol<ref name="auto2">{{cite web |title=Europol and Telegram take on terrorist propaganda online |url=https://www.europol.europa.eu/media-press/newsroom/news/europol-and-telegram-take-terrorist-propaganda-online |website=Europol |access-date=19 April 2024 |language=en}}</ref> to eliminate ISIS presence on the platform, but communities of far-right extremist users are still on the app. Such content is usually linked to Telegram allowing misinformation on the platform as, according to Pavel Durov, "conspiracy theories only strengthen each time their content is removed by moderators".<ref>{{cite web |title=Du Rove's Channel |url=https://t.me/durov/163 |website=Telegram |date=20 July 2021 |access-date=19 April 2024 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240422115238/https://t.me/s/durov/163 |archive-date=22 April 2024 }}</ref>

In September 2024, Telegram announced that it would begin to hand over users' IP addresses and phone numbers to authorities who have search warrants or other valid legal requests.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 September 2024 |title=Telegram will now provide some user data to authorities |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvglp0xny3eo |access-date=12 November 2024 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>

===Russian use for destabilization activities===
Martin Jäger, the head of Germany's [[Federal Intelligence Service]] (BND), warned that Russia was recruiting saboteurs across Europe through Telegram by monitoring pro-Russian channels to identify potential "low-level agents" for small acts of sabotage, surveillance or provocation in exchange of small payments.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.euronews.com/2025/10/28/putins-secret-terror-in-germany-how-russia-recruits-its-agents-one-click-at-a-time|title=Putin's secret terror in Germany: How Russia recruits its agents, one click at a time|first=Johanna|last=Urbancik|newspaper=[[Euronews]]|date=27 October 2025}}</ref>

According to a study by the international analysis company OpenMinds published on the eve of the [[2025 Moldovan parliamentary election]], which was subject to [[Foreign election interference|external interference]] from Russia, a third of all Telegram channels in [[Moldova]] systematically spread [[State propaganda in the Russian Federation|Russian propaganda]] and one in eight comments came from [[Internet bot|bots]].<ref>{{cite news |date=26 September 2025 |title=Каждый третий телеграм-канал в Молдове распространяет кремлёвскую пропаганду — отчет OpenMinds |url=https://nokta.md/kazhdyj-tretij-telegram-kanal-v-moldove-rasprostranyaet-kremljovskuju-propagandu-otchet-openminds/ |work=[[Nokta (Moldova)|Nokta]] |language=ru}}</ref> Moldovan president [[Maia Sandu]] denounced that Telegram refused any collaboration with the Moldovan state authorities against illegal activities taking place in its platform such as [[vote buying]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://agora.md/2025/09/25/sandu-telegram-spatiu-de-cumparare-a-voturilor-si-de-vanzare-a-drogurilor-zero-colaborare-din-partea-platformei|title=Sandu: Telegram, spațiu de cumpărare a voturilor și de vânzare a drogurilor. Zero colaborare din partea platformei|first=Capitolina|last=Turculeț|newspaper=Agora|date=25 September 2025|language=ro}}</ref>

===Use by militant groups===
In September 2015, in response to a question about the use of Telegram by [[Islamic State]] (ISIS), Pavel Durov stated: "I think that privacy, ultimately, and our right for privacy is more important than our fear of bad things happening, like [[terrorism]]."<ref name="TC2015Messages" /> Durov sarcastically suggested to ban words because terrorists use them for communication.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vesti.ru/doc.html?id=2687387|title=Дуров о запрете на Telegram: предлагаю запретить слова, с помощью них общаются террористы|website=vesti.ru|language=ru|access-date=24 April 2018|archive-date=2 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190502055024/https://www.vesti.ru/doc.html?id=2687387|url-status=live}}</ref>

ISIS has used Telegram for recruiting attempts with some cells recommending the app<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hamblen |first1=Matt |title=Paris attacks demand 'wake-up call' on smartphone encryption |url=https://www.csoonline.com/article/3005570/paris-attacks-demand-wake-up-call-on-smartphone-encryption.html |website=CSO Online |language=en}}</ref> to their followers. In France, initial investigations<ref name=":1">{{cite news|url=http://www.cnn.com/2016/08/01/europe/france-church-attack-telegram/index.html|title=Killers of French priest met 4 days before attack|first1=Margot|last1=Haddad|first2=Tim|last2=Hume|publisher=cnn.com|access-date=24 September 2016|archive-date=12 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512224348/https://www.cnn.com/2016/08/01/europe/france-church-attack-telegram/index.html|url-status=live}}</ref> of a terrorist act revealed the perpetrators used Telegram to communicate, though follow-up research suggested that the extent of the app's use was "unclear".<ref>{{cite web |last1=Stone |first1=Jeff |title=ISIS Terrorists Used 'Burner' Phones: Report |url=https://www.ibtimes.com/isis-terrorists-used-disposable-burner-phones-activated-just-hours-carry-out-paris-2340265 |website=International Business Times |date=21 March 2016}}</ref> Beginning in December 2016, Telegram began publishing daily moderation statistics regarding terror-related content in an official channel named @ISISwatch.<ref>{{cite web |title=ISIS Watch |url=http://t.me/ISISwatch |website=Telegram}}</ref> Following efforts by Telegram to remove ISIS-related content from the platform,<ref name="auto2"/><ref>{{cite web|title=Indonesian government lifts ban on messaging service Telegram|url=http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesian-government-lifts-ban-on-messaging-service-telegram|website=The Straits Times|publisher=SPH Digital News|date=11 August 2017|access-date=30 December 2017|archive-date=12 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190512225245/https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesian-government-lifts-ban-on-messaging-service-telegram|url-status=live}}</ref> the terrorist organization reportedly moved its recruitment groups to the dark web,<ref>{{cite web|title = Encrypted messaging app Telegram shuts down Islamic State propaganda channels|url = https://www.telegraph.co.uk/technology/news/12004892/Encrypted-messaging-app-Telegram-shuts-down-Islamic-State-propaganda-channels.html|website = Telegraph.co.uk| date=19 November 2015 |access-date = 19 November 2015|archive-date = 12 May 2019|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190512224337/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/technology/news/12004892/Encrypted-messaging-app-Telegram-shuts-down-Islamic-State-propaganda-channels.html|url-status = live}}</ref> with US officials citing the app's purging of terrorist content as particularly effective<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.voanews.com/a/europe_struggles-regain-social-media-footing-after-europe-crackdown/6180532.html|title=IS Struggles to Regain Social Media Footing After Europe Crackdown|website=Voice of America|date=4 December 2019 |language=en|access-date=5 December 2019|archive-date=8 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200808102410/https://www.voanews.com/europe/struggles-regain-social-media-footing-after-europe-crackdown|url-status=live}}</ref> at deplatforming ISIS.

[[Hamas]] and the [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] used Telegram heavily during their [[October 7 attacks|October 7 attack on Southern Israel]] to disseminate attack-related images, videos, and other propaganda.<ref>{{Cite web |last=McCafferty |first=Sean |title=Comment: Moderation of terrorist content since October 7th and a lack of adversarial shift |url=https://www.crestresearch.ac.uk/comment/moderation-of-terrorist-content-since-october-7th-and-a-lack-of-adversarial-shift/ |access-date=2026-06-27 |website=[[Center for Research and Evidence on Security Threats]] |language=en-GB|date=12 September 2024}}</ref>

In 2023, Saudi Arabia's [[Global Center for Combating Extremist Ideology]] (Etidal) reported that in collaboration with Telegram, over 59 million pieces of extremist content had been removed from the platform since 2022.<ref>{{cite web |title=Saudi Arabia's Etidal, Telegram remove 59m items of extremist content since 2022 |url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/2445716/saudi-arabia |website=Arab News |language=en |date=21 January 2024}}</ref>

Throughout 2020, the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] used groups and channels to dox Iraqi and Iranian citizens, while sharing propagandistic posts on the platform.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lawati |first1=Abbas Al |title=Cartoons and Quranic verses form the latest Saudi-Iran battleground |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/04/middleeast/iran-saudi-cartoons-quran-mime-intl/index.html |website=CNN |language=en |date=4 November 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.cjr.org/the_feature/iraqi-journalists-watch-telegram-telegram-is-watching-them-back.php | title=Iraqi journalists watch Telegram. Telegram is watching them back |date=November 10, 2022|website=[[Columbia Journalism Review]]}}</ref> After the 2021 coup d'état in Myanmar, the junta used Telegram channels to spread propaganda<ref name=":10">{{Cite web |date=9 June 2022 |title=How Myanmar lobbyists use Telegram to spread propaganda, fake news |url=https://www.mizzima.com/article/how-myanmar-lobbyists-use-telegram-spread-propaganda-fake-news |access-date=21 March 2023 |website=Mizzima Myanmar News and Insight |language=en}}</ref> and organize misinformation campaigns against pro-democracy groups. In response to the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights call to prevent such abuse, Telegram reportedly banned 13 accounts related to or supporting the Myanmar military.<ref name=":9">{{Cite web |title=Myanmar: Social media companies must stand up to junta's online terror campaign say UN experts |url=https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2023/03/myanmar-social-media-companies-must-stand-juntas-online-terror-campaign-say |access-date=21 March 2023 |website=OHCHR |language=en|date=13 March 2023}}</ref>

On 26 April 2023, Telegram was temporarily suspended in Brazil and fined {{BRLConvert|1|m|year=2023|force=yes}} per day for not complying with a [[Federal Police of Brazil|Federal Police]] investigation into neo-Nazi activities on the platform. The company only partially fulfilled a court request for personal data on two antisemitic Telegram groups, which authorities considered an intentional lack of cooperation. The decision was made after a series of violent school attacks, with at least one incident linked to exchanges on an antisemitic group.<ref>{{cite news |title=Brazil court suspends Telegram app in neo-Nazi probe |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230426-brazil-court-suspends-telegram-app-in-neo-nazi-probe |access-date=27 April 2023 |work=France 24 |agency=Agen ce France-Presse |date=26 April 2023 |location=Rio de Janeiro}}</ref> Telegram's CEO then said that the requested data was technologically impossible to obtain.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telegram CEO claims complying with Brazil order impossible |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/04/27/telegram-brazil-block/2ec1c1de-e554-11ed-9696-8e874fd710b8_story.html |access-date=10 May 2023 |newspaper=The Washington Post |date=27 April 2023}}</ref> A federal court lifted the suspension three days later but upheld the daily fine.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telegram app back on in Brazil after judge lifts suspension |url=https://thehill.com/homenews/ap/ap-technology/telegram-app-back-on-in-brazil-after-judge-lifts-suspension/ |access-date=30 April 2023 |work=The Hill |agency=Associated Press |date=29 April 2023}}</ref> Twelve days later, Telegram told its users that the [[Brazilian Congressional Bill No. 2630]] against online disinformation, which was about to be approved, would end [[freedom of speech]] in the country.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telegram calls Brazil disinformation law 'attack on democracy' |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230509-telegram-calls-brazil-disinformation-law-attack-on-democracy |access-date=10 May 2023 |work=France 24 |agency=Agence France-Presse |date=9 May 2023}}</ref>

Far-right and [[white supremacist]] communities on Telegram have spread videos of the [[Christchurch mosque shootings|Christchurch]] and [[Halle synagogue shooting|Halle]] shootings<ref name=":8">{{cite web |date=2 December 2019 |title=Telegram: The Latest Safe Haven for White Supremacists |url=https://www.adl.org/blog/telegram-the-latest-safe-haven-for-white-supremacists |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201117191415/https://www.adl.org/blog/telegram-the-latest-safe-haven-for-white-supremacists |archive-date=17 November 2020 |access-date=11 March 2020 |website=[[Anti-Defamation League]]}}</ref> in groups and channels after the original livestreams were taken down by Twitch. British far-right publication TR.news,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Rogers |first1=Richard |title=Deplatforming: Following extreme Internet celebrities to Telegram and alternative social media |journal=European Journal of Communication |date=June 2020 |volume=35 |issue=3 |pages=213–229 |doi=10.1177/0267323120922066 |hdl=11245.1/19464dfd-805b-489b-b312-2936eb900cba |hdl-access=free }}</ref> following multiple deplatformings, launched a Telegram channel to spread its posts and the Institute for Strategic Dialogue<ref>{{cite web|last=Lanigan|first=Michael|url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/telegram-is-the-far-rights-weapon-of-choice-in-ireland/|title=Telegram Is the Far-Right's Weapon of Choice in Ireland|date=30 April 2021|website=Vice|access-date=2 May 2021|archive-date=2 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210502124822/https://www.vice.com/en/article/93yw4p/telegram-is-the-far-rights-weapon-of-choice-in-ireland|url-status=live}}</ref> reported that Irish far-right groups grew substantially between 2019 and 2020. But research by Oxford University<ref name="comprop.oii.ox.ac.uk">{{cite web|website=The Computational Propaganda Project|title=Junk News Distribution on Telegram: The Visibility of English-language News Sources on Public Telegram Channels|date=20 July 2020|access-date=1 November 2020|url=https://comprop.oii.ox.ac.uk/research/posts/junk-news-distribution-on-telegram-the-visibility-of-english-language-news-sources-on-public-telegram-channels/|archive-date=3 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201203103647/https://comprop.oii.ox.ac.uk/research/posts/junk-news-distribution-on-telegram-the-visibility-of-english-language-news-sources-on-public-telegram-channels/|url-status=live}}</ref> suggests that, because Telegram does not use sorting algorithms in its search function, many such groups remain obscure and small while select others receive a lot of attention.

=== Illegal pornography ===
Telegram has been used to distribute illegal [[pornography]], including [[child pornography]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mashable.com/article/nudes-revenge-porn-crime-telegram/|title=Telegram's massive revenge porn problem has made these women's lives hell|date=29 October 2020|website=Mashable|access-date=28 January 2021|archive-date=28 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210128165434/https://mashable.com/article/nudes-revenge-porn-crime-telegram/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://theprint.in/tech/rape-videos-child-porn-terror-telegram-anonymity-is-giving-criminals-a-free-run/307959/|title=Rape videos, child porn, terror — Telegram anonymity is giving criminals a free run|date=19 October 2019|website=The Print|access-date=28 January 2021|archive-date=8 February 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210208201355/https://theprint.in/tech/rape-videos-child-porn-terror-telegram-anonymity-is-giving-criminals-a-free-run/307959/|url-status=live}}</ref> Telegram's internal reporting system has an option to report content that contains child abuse, including specific messages in groups and channels. The company has a verified channel called "Stop Child Abuse", where daily statistics on the number of groups and channels banned for sharing illegal materials are posted. It also provides an email address dedicated to reports of content related to child abuse.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://t.me/s/stopCA |title=Stop Child Abuse – Telegram |website=Telegram |access-date=24 September 2021 |url-status=live |archive-date=15 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211115225608/https://t.me/s/stopCA }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2021/01/15/asia/south-korea-telegram-digital-sex-intl-hnk-dst/index.html |title=South Korea is cracking down on digital sex crimes. Has it done enough? |date=17 January 2021 |website=CNN |access-date=24 September 2021 |url-status=live |archive-date=24 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210924162734/https://edition.cnn.com/2021/01/15/asia/south-korea-telegram-digital-sex-intl-hnk-dst/index.html }}</ref>

In January 2021, [[North Macedonia]]n media outlets reported that a now-banned Telegram group, "Public Room" ("Јавна соба"), with more than 7,000 members, was used to share nude photos of women and young teenage girls.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://english.republika.mk/news/macedonia/users-of-telegram-group-where-pictures-of-underage-girls-were-shared-are-threatening-the-woman-who-reported-them/|title=Users of Telegram group where pictures of underage girls were shared are threatening the woman who reported them|date=27 January 2021|website=Republika English|access-date=28 January 2021|archive-date=27 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210127095816/https://english.republika.mk/news/macedonia/users-of-telegram-group-where-pictures-of-underage-girls-were-shared-are-threatening-the-woman-who-reported-them/|url-status=live}}</ref> Along with the shared photographs, anonymous accounts shared the women's private information, including phone numbers and social media profiles, encouraging members of the group to contact the women and ask for sexual favors.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://english.republika.mk/news/macedonia/one-of-the-girls-whose-pictures-were-shared-in-a-telegram-group-demands-action/|title=One of the girls whose pictures were shared in a Telegram group demands action|date=27 January 2021|website=Republika English|access-date=28 January 2021|archive-date=27 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210127134346/https://english.republika.mk/news/macedonia/one-of-the-girls-whose-pictures-were-shared-in-a-telegram-group-demands-action/|url-status=live}}</ref> This was done without the women's agreement or knowledge, causing intense public backlash and demand that the group be shut down. North Macedonia President [[Stevo Pendarovski]] and Prime Minister [[Zoran Zaev]] demanded an immediate response from Telegram and threatened to completely restrict access to the app in the country if no action was taken.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://english.republika.mk/news/macedonia/calls-to-shut-down-telegram-group-used-to-share-pictures-of-underage-girls/|title=Calls to shut down Telegram group used to share pictures of underage girls|date=28 January 2021|website=Republika English|access-date=28 January 2021|archive-date=28 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210128111846/https://english.republika.mk/news/macedonia/calls-to-shut-down-telegram-group-used-to-share-pictures-of-underage-girls/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://twitter.com/Zoran_Zaev/status/1354759939902894081 |title=Зоран Заев on Twitter |access-date=28 January 2021 |archive-date=28 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210128115555/https://twitter.com/Zoran_Zaev/status/1354759939902894081 |url-status=live }}</ref> The group was banned, but no public statement was made.

An August 2024 [[BBC]] investigation found that Telegram had not responded to requests to join the US–based [[National Center for Missing & Exploited Children]] (NCMEC) or the UK–based [[Internet Watch Foundation]], both nonprofit [[Non-governmental Organizations|NGO]]s. In response, Telegram said that it "proactively moderates harmful content on its platform including child abuse material" and that its moderation is "within industry standards and constantly improving".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy54905nv0go|title=Telegram repeatedly refuses to join child protection schemes|website=BBC News|access-date=28 August 2024}}</ref>

In August 2024, journalist Ko Narin of [[the Hankyoreh]] exposed Telegram chats of teenagers who used [[generative AI]] to deepfake images of their classmates and teachers for porn.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpdlpj9zn9go|title=Inside the deep fake porn crisis engulfing Korean schools|date=3 September 2024 |publisher=BBC News}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.npr.org/2024/09/06/nx-s1-5101891/south-korea-deepfake|title=South Korea investigates Telegram over alleged sexual deepfakes|work=NPR |date=6 September 2024 |last1=Gong |first1=Se Eun }}</ref>

A February 2026 BBC investigation by journalist Wanqing Zhang found that Telegram was widely used to advertise and distribute non-consensual [[hidden camera]] pornography, including footage secretly filmed in hotel rooms across China, and that requests to remove such content often went unanswered. In response, Telegram said that sharing non-consensual pornography is forbidden under its terms of service and that it "proactively moderates" harmful content on the platform.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c62rexy9y3no|title=We had sex in a Chinese hotel, then found we had been broadcast to thousands|first=Wanqing|last=Zhang|work=BBC|date=2026-02-07|access-date=2026-02-10}}</ref>

=== Bot abuse ===
Volodymyr Flents, the chairman of the public organization "Electronic Democracy", announced on 11 May 2020 that a Telegram bot appeared on the Web, which sold the personal data of Ukrainian citizens. It is estimated that the bot contains data from 26 million Ukrainians registered in the [[Diia]] application. But deputy prime minister and minister of digital transformation [[Mykhailo Fedorov]] denied that any data from the app had leaked. The criminal activity of 25 people was confirmed and copies of 30 databases were seized.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Утечка данных из анонимного Тelegram-канала: объявили 25 подозрений|url=https://www.ukrinform.ru/rubric-society/3051656-utecka-dannyh-iz-anonimnogo-telegramkanala-obavili-25-podozrenij.html|website=www.ukrinform.ru|access-date=25 June 2020|archive-date=11 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201111073614/https://www.ukrinform.ru/rubric-society/3051656-utecka-dannyh-iz-anonimnogo-telegramkanala-obavili-25-podozrenij.html|url-status=usurped}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=19 June 2020|title=Cyber police searched for leaks in public and private databases &#124; Techumble|url=https://techumble.com/cyber-%e2%80%8b%e2%80%8bpolice-searched-for-leaks-in-public-and-private-databases/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200628012411/https://techumble.com/cyber-%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8Bpolice-searched-for-leaks-in-public-and-private-databases/|url-status=dead|archive-date=28 June 2020|website=techumble.com|access-date=13 May 2021}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=12 May 2020|title=Ukrainian data leak via telegram: MP will send requests to SBU and police &#124; Techumble|url=https://techumble.com/ukrainian-data-leak-via-telegram-mp-will-send-requests-to-sbu-and-police/|website=techumble.com|access-date=25 June 2020|archive-date=25 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025142849/https://techumble.com/ukrainian-data-leak-via-telegram-mp-will-send-requests-to-sbu-and-police/|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2020, Apple blocked a Telegram bot after it posted [[deepfake pornography]].<ref>{{Cite news|title=The AI Telegram bot that abused women is still out of control|language=en-GB|magazine=Wired UK|url=https://www.wired.co.uk/article/porn-bots-in-telegram-deepfake|access-date=27 June 2021|issn=1357-0978|archive-date=27 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210127065028/https://www.wired.co.uk/article/porn-bots-in-telegram-deepfake|url-status=live}}</ref> The same year, Telegram reportedly banned more than 350,000 bots and channels, including those that contained child abuse and terrorism-related content.<ref name="auto4"/>

In 2021, a bot was found selling leaked phone numbers from Facebook.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Facebook users' phone numbers are for sale through a Telegram bot|url=https://www.theverge.com/2021/1/25/22249571/facebook-phone-number-hack-telegram-bot|access-date=26 January 2021|website=www.theverge.com|date=25 January 2021|language=en|archive-date=26 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210126113721/https://www.theverge.com/2021/1/25/22249571/facebook-phone-number-hack-telegram-bot|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Fraudulent jobs===
Telegram has received criticism for its failure to curb fraud. The most common mode of fraud involves scammers sending messages to unsuspecting users, offering part-time online jobs that comprise a series of tasks. Scammers employ a variety of [[confidence tricks]] to entice users into completing "prepaid tasks" in which users deposit money into scammers' accounts with the expectation of receiving high returns.<ref>{{cite news |title=Several job-seekers cheated in Telegram scam, Tambaram police urge cellphone users to be vigilant |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/several-job-seekers-in-telegram-scam-tambaram-urge-cellphone-users-to-be-vigilant/article66900587.ece |access-date=30 October 2023 |work=The Hindu |date=28 May 2023 |language=en-IN}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Don't take the bait dropped through that missed call |url=https://www.onmanorama.com/news/india/2023/05/25/online-fraid-missed-call-telegram-whatsapp.html |access-date=30 October 2023 |work=OnManorama}}</ref>

In July 2023, [[Hyderabad Police]] uncovered a fraud wherein 15,000 Indian citizens were duped out of {{INRconvert|712|c}} in less than a year, all related to "prepaid tasks" on Telegram. A cybercrime police investigation of the money trail revealed that the fraud originated in China and the money was laundered by [[money mule|mules]] through [[cryptocurrency wallets]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Fraudsters dupe 15,000 people of ₹712 crore, launders money to China |url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/fraudsters-dupe-15-000-people-of-rs-712-crore-launders-money-to-china-this-is-how-they-operated-11690206228894.html |access-date=30 October 2023 |work=mint |date=24 July 2023 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=No platform is fool proof, says Telegram on Rs 712 crore investment fraud |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/no-platform-is-fool-proof-says-telegram-on-rs-712-crore-investment-fraud-11063831.html |access-date=30 October 2023 |work=Moneycontrol |date=31 July 2023 |language=en}}</ref>

In September 2023, the [[Singapore Police Force]] stated that more than 6,600 Singaporeans had lost over {{SGDConvert|96.8|m}} to prepaid job scams on Telegram and WhatsApp since the start of the year.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Sin |first1=Carmen |title=Police warn of online job scam; 6,600 victims have lost $96.8m since January |url=https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/police-warn-of-fake-online-job-scam-6600-victims-lost-968m-since-january |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=The Straits Times |date=16 September 2023 |language=en}}</ref>

=== Copyright infringement ===
In March 2024, a judge of Spain's [[Audiencia Nacional]] ordered the temporary blocking of Telegram in Spain. The order came following a complaint from media organizations —[[Mediaset España|Mediaset]], [[Atresmedia]] and [[Movistar Plus+]]— saying the app allowed users to share copyrighted content without their consent.<ref>{{cite news|title=Spain's High Court orders block on Telegram messaging app as a precautionary measure|url=https://www.euronews.com/next/2024/03/23/spains-high-court-orders-block-on-telegram-messaging-app-as-a-precautionary-measure |work=Euronews |date=23 March 2024 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=High Court orders temporary suspension of Telegram's services in Spain|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/high-court-orders-temporary-suspension-telegrams-services-spain-2024-03-23/ |work=[[Reuters]] |date=23 March 2024 |language=en}}</ref> A few days later, following repeated criticism, the same judge suspended his order until the police issue a report on the consequences this measure would have for users.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Marraco |first1=Manuel |last2=Diego Madueño |first2=Juan |date=25 March 2024 |title=Pedraz suspende el bloqueo de Telegram hasta recibir un informe sobre la incidencia en los usuarios |url=https://www.elmundo.es/papel/2024/03/25/66014c77e9cf4a84758b4570.html |access-date=25 March 2024 |work=[[El Mundo (Spain)|El Mundo]] |language=es}}</ref> Finally, the judge annulled the order, considering it "disproportionate".

=== Drug trade ===
In recent years, Telegram has become more popular for the purpose of buying and selling illicit drugs. In 2024, Sociology Compass released a paper exploring this trend in drug trade.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dewey |first1=Matías |last2=Buzzetti |first2=Andrés |date=February 2024 |title=Easier, faster and safer: The social organization of drug dealing through encrypted messaging apps |journal=Sociology Compass |language=en |volume=18 |issue=2 |article-number=e13175 |doi=10.1111/soc4.13175 |issn=1751-9020|doi-access=free }}</ref>

=== User numbers ===
In August 2024, an EU probe was launched into Telegram to determine whether the platform breached EU digital rules by failing to provide accurate user numbers.<ref name="Financial Times">{{Cite news |last1=Klasa |first1=Adrienne |last2=Foy |first2=Henry |last3=Hancock |first3=Alice |last4=Tamma |first4=Paola |date=28 August 2024 |title=EU investigating Telegram over user numbers |url=https://www.ft.com/content/1f96e66d-00fe-46ca-9cb8-73e526125922 |access-date=12 November 2024 |work=Financial Times}}</ref> Telegram said in February  2024 that it had 41mn users in the EU. Under the EU's [[Digital Services Act]] (DSA), Telegram was supposed to provide an updated number in August but failed to do so, only declaring it had "significantly fewer than 45mn average monthly active recipients in the EU".<ref name="Financial Times"/>

=== Advertisements ===
As part of the monetization model, Telegram can display advertisement banners for non-premium users in public channels with more than 1000 subscribers. The revenue of these advertisements is shared with the channel owner in form of Telegram's Toncoin crypto currency.<ref>{{cite web |author=<!-- not stated --> |date=31 March 2024 |title=Sharing Revenue with Channel Owners |url=https://telegram.org/blog/monetization-for-channels |website=telegram.org |access-date=14 August 2025}}</ref>{{Primary source inline|date=August 2026}} As of August 2025, there was no option for channel owners to opt out of this mechanism. This is seen as an issue for non-profit organizations and similar entities who want to operate a Telegram channel.{{Citation needed|date=August 2026}}

In August 2025, the German public media broadcaster [[Norddeutscher Rundfunk|NDR]] closed its ''tagesschau'' Telegram channel, which published summaries of news stories from the [[Tagesschau (German TV programme)|German television news service]] by the same name. The TV program and news stories are produced for the joint organization [[ARD (broadcaster)|ARD]] to be simulcast by its members. The editorial staff was made aware of the advertisement by a Telegram user and the online magazine [[Übermedien]]. They argued the advertisements could be seen as a violation of the ''[[Rundfunkstaatsvertrag]]'' (Interstate Broadcasting Agreement), which places strict rules on how German public media broadcasters may generate revenue from advertisements, including an advertisement ban for online media apart from product placement. Additional criticism was expressed as some advertisements were described as "shady" or "fraudulent" offerings on sports bets. The NDR said it had not noticed these ads before, but closed the channel, saying that an advertisement-based accumulation of Toncoin, albeit unsolicited and not withdrawn, was unacceptable for a German public media broadcaster.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Schneider |first1=Annika |date=7 August 2025 |title=Tagesschau: Dubiose Werbung im Telegram-Kanal |language=de |url=https://uebermedien.de/107997/der-kryptobot-der-tagesschau/ |access-date=14 August 2025 |work=Übermedien}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=9 August 2025 |title=Chatbot: Wie die ARD auf Telegram fast an betrügerischen Sportwetten verdiente |language=de |url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/feuilleton/medien-und-film/medienpolitik/chatbot-wie-die-ard-auf-telegram-fast-an-betruegerischen-sportwetten-verdiente-110630084.html |access-date=14 August 2025 |agency=F.A.Z./epd |work=FAZ |publisher=Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung}}</ref>

===Use by scam syndicates===
In 2025, Telegram said it blocked [[Huione Group|Huione Guarantee]], which [[Elliptic (company)|Elliptic]] described as an escrow-style marketplace operating across thousands of Telegram channels and widely used by online scammers based in [[scam centers in Cambodia]].<ref name="ReutersTelegramBlocked2025">{{cite news |title=2 massive black market services blocked by Telegram, messaging app says |work=Reuters |date=15 May 2025 |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/china/2-massive-black-market-services-blocked-by-telegram-messaging-app-says-2025-05-15/}}</ref><ref name="EllipticCyberScamMarketplace">{{cite web |title=Huione Guarantee: The multi-billion dollar marketplace used by online scammers |website=Elliptic |url=https://www.elliptic.co/blog/cyber-scam-marketplace}}</ref> Huione lists businessman [[Hun To]], cousin of [[Cambodia]]n Prime Minister [[Hun Manet]], as a director.<ref name="ReutersHuionePayLazarus2024">{{cite news |last=Wilson |first=Tom |title=Exclusive: North Korean hackers sent stolen crypto to wallet used by Asian payment firm |work=Reuters |date=15 July 2024 |url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/cybersecurity/north-korean-hackers-sent-stolen-crypto-wallet-used-by-asian-payment-firm-2024-07-15/}}</ref>

===Use for sexual violence===
In 2024, German law enforcement uncovered an [[German Driving School Telegram rape network|international criminal network]] operating on Telegram under the name "Fahrschule für Experten in Deutschland" (lit. 'German Old Driver Driving School'). Composed primarily of Chinese nationals residing in Europe and North America, the group used encrypted Telegram chats to coordinate, instruct, and share recorded media of drug-facilitated sexual assaults. Members used specialized automotive terminology as coded language to refer to victims. The group also facilitated the illegal sale and distribution of prescription sedatives and medical anesthetics. International law enforcement cooperation led to multiple arrests and convictions across several jurisdictions, including Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States.<ref name=":TAZ">{{cite web| url= https://taz.de/Sexualisierte-Gewalt/!6164544/ |title="Man darf nicht zulassen, dass sie zu sich kommt" |first= Anne| last= Fromm| first2= Sophie| last2= Fichtner| newspaper= TAZ| trans-title=" You mustn't allow her to come to her senses." |language= de| date= 2026-04-03 |access-date= 2026-07-29}}</ref>

=== Aggregation of Leaked Data ===
Telegram has been criticized for a vulnerability that makes it possible to connect a user's numerical ID with other personal information. The ID itself does not reveal one's phone number or full name, but it can be used to trace a Telegram account through public profiles, previous usernames, group activity, and data stored in third-party databases.<ref>{{Cite web |date= 2026-08-12 |title= Как вас деанонят в Telegram, даже если профиль закрыт? Разбор #27 |url= https://te-st.org/2026/08/12/insidetele/ |access-date= 2026-09-01 |language= ru-RU}}</ref>

OSINT services such as "Glaz Boga"<ref>{{Cite web |title= Как ограничить выдачу своих данных в «Глазе Бога» |url= https://dept.one/memo/glaz-boga/ |access-date= 2026-09-01 |website= Первый отдел |language= ru-RU}}</ref> can start with a Telegram ID and retrieve information from multiple sources. Some of this data comes from Russian leaks, including the Yandex Food and Gemotest breaches.<ref>{{Cite web |title= Putin welcomes idea of criminalizing leaked personal data use |url= https://meduza.io/en/news/2022/12/07/putin-welcomes-idea-of-criminalizing-leaked-personal-data-use |access-date= 2026-09-01 |website= Meduza |language= en}}</ref> As a result, a Telegram ID can yield a much broader range of personal information than a person has publicly shared on their Telegram profile.

Leak aggregators have also obtained datasets sourced directly from Telegram. Media reports have described databases maintained by services that collect and sell personal information, including users' requests to Telegram Support.<ref>{{Cite web |last= elena |date= 2026-05-18 |title= В сеть могли утечь обращения в службу поддержки Telegram |url= https://baikal-journal.ru/2026/05/18/v-set-mogli-utech-obrashheniya-v-sluzhbu-podderzhki-telegram/ |access-date= 2026-09-01 |website= Люди Байкала |language= ru-RU}}</ref> These records contained Telegram IDs, usernames, and messages sent to support. In some cases, they also included names, phone numbers, device information, and details showing whether a user had a Telegram Premium subscription.

== Reception ==
Channels have been used by celebrities such as [[Arnold Schwarzenegger]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=Schwarzenegger |first1=Arnold |title=You can and anyone you know also find this on my new Telegram channel if that is easier |url=https://twitter.com/Schwarzenegger/status/1504429787481194499 |website=Twitter }}</ref> and [[Snoop Dogg]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Snoop Dogg |url=https://t.me/snoopdogg |access-date=2025-06-15 |website= Telegram}}</ref> and politicians: [[President of France]] [[Emmanuel Macron]],<ref name="MacronTelegram" /> former [[President of Brazil]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jair M. Bolsonaro 1 |url=https://t.me/jairbolsonarobrasil |access-date=1 July 2022 |website=Telegram}}</ref> [[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Recep Tayyip Erdoğan |url=https://t.me/RTErdogan |access-date=1 July 2022 |website=Telegram}}</ref> [[President of Moldova]] [[Maia Sandu]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=🇲🇩 Președintele Maia Sandu |url=https://t.me/maiasandumd/16 |access-date=10 June 2022 |website= Telegram}}</ref> [[President of Ukraine]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]],<ref name="TimeZelenskyy"/> former [[President of Mexico]] [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Andrés Manuel López Obrador |url=https://t.me/PresidenteAMLO |access-date=1 July 2022 |website=Telegram}}</ref> former [[Prime Minister of Singapore|Singaporean Prime Minister]] [[Lee Hsien Loong]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lee Hsien Loong |url= https://t.me/leehsienloong |access-date=1 July 2022 |website=Telegram}}</ref> [[President of Uzbekistan]] [[Shavkat Mirziyoyev]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Shavkat Mirziyoyev_press-service |url=https://t.me/shmirziyoyev |access-date=2025-06-15 |website=Telegram}}</ref> former [[President of the Republic of China|Taiwan President]] [[Tsai Ing-wen]], [[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Ethiopian Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Abiy Ahmed Ali 🇪🇹 |url=https://t.me/AbiyAhmedAliofficial |access-date= 2025-06-15 |website=Telegram}}</ref> [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=בנימין נתניהו |url=https://t.me/bnetanyahu |access-date=2025-06-15 |website= Telegram}}</ref> and others.

=== Security ===
{{Main|Reception of Telegram Security Features}}

In 2016, cryptography experts criticized how, unless modified, Telegram's default general security model stores all contacts, messages and media together with their decryption keys on its servers continuously and does not enable [[end-to-end encryption]] for messages.<ref name= "cpj-2016-05-31">{{cite web |date= 31 May 2016 |title= Why Telegram's security flaws may put Iran's journalists at risk |url= https://cpj.org/blog/2016/05/why-telegrams-security-flaws-may-put-irans-journal.php |url-status= live |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20160819013449/https://cpj.org/blog/2016/05/why-telegrams-security-flaws-may-put-irans-journal.php |archive-date= 19 August 2016 |access-date= 20 July 2016 |publisher= Committee to Protect Journalists}}</ref><ref name= "Turton-2016-06-24">{{cite web| last1= Turton|first1= William| title= Why You Should Stop Using Telegram Right Now| url= https://gizmodo.com/why-you-should-stop-using-telegram-right-now-1782557415| website= Gizmodo| publisher= Gawker Media| access-date= 22 December 2020| date= 24 June 2016| archive-date= 8 July 2016| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20160708145705/http://gizmodo.com/why-you-should-stop-using-telegram-right-now-1782557415| url-status= live}}</ref> Durov has argued that this is because it helps to avoid third-party unsecured backups, and to allow users to access messages and files from any device. Criticisms were also aimed at Telegram's use of a custom-designed encryption protocol.<ref name= "cpj-2016-05-31" /><ref name= "Jakobsen 2015">{{harvnb|Jakobsen|Orlandi|2015}}</ref><ref name= "Cox-2015">{{cite web| last1= Cox| first1= Joseph| title= Why You Don't Roll Your Own Crypto| url= https://www.vice.com/en/article/why-you-dont-roll-your-own-crypto/| website= Motherboard| publisher= [[Vice Media]]| access-date= 22 December 2020| date= 10 December 2015| archive-date= 26 December 2016| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20161226174309/http://motherboard.vice.com/read/why-you-dont-roll-your-own-crypto| url-status= live}}</ref><ref name= "dailydot.com">{{cite news| last1= Turton| first1= William| title= Cryptography expert casts doubt on encryption in ISIS' favorite messaging app| url= http://www.dailydot.com/politics/telegram-isis-encryption-cryptography/| website= The Daily Dot| access-date= 11 December 2015| date= 19 November 2015| archive-date= 27 June 2016| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20160627184947/http://www.dailydot.com/politics/telegram-isis-encryption-cryptography/| url-status= live}}</ref>

In December 2020, a study titled "Automated Symbolic Verification of Telegram's MTProto 2.0" was published, confirming the security of the updated MTProto 2.0 and reviewing it while pointing out several theoretical vulnerabilities.<ref name="Miculan 2020">{{harvnb|Miculan|Vitacolonna|2020}}</ref><ref name= "Miculan 2023">{{harvnb|Miculan|Vitacolonna|2023}}</ref> The paper provides "fully automated proof of the soundness of MTProto 2.0's authentication, normal chat, end-to-end encrypted chat, and re-keying mechanisms with respect to several security properties, including authentication, integrity, confidentiality and perfect forward secrecy" and "proves the formal correctness of MTProto 2.0". This partially addresses the concern about the lack of scrutiny while confirming the formal security of the protocol's latest version.<ref name= "Miculan 2020"/><ref name= "Miculan 2023"/>

As of 2014, the desktop clients, excluding the [[macOS]] client, do not feature options for end-to-end encrypted messages. When the user assigns a local password in the desktop application, data is also locally encrypted. Telegram has defended the lack of ubiquitous end-to-end encryption by saying that online-backups that do not use [[client-side encryption]] are "the most secure solution currently possible".<ref>{{cite web| url= https://telegram.org/faq#q-why-not-just-make-all-chats-secret| title= Telegram F.A.Q.| website= Telegram| access-date= 1 October 2017| archive-date= 9 February 2014| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20140209082001/https://telegram.org/faq#q-why-not-just-make-all-chats-secret| url-status= live}}</ref>{{Update inline| date= August 2026}}{{Primary source inline| date= August 2026}}

Security researcher [[Moxie Marlinspike]], founder of the competing [[Signal (messaging app)|Signal]] messenger, and commenters on [[Hacker News]] criticized a 2013 contest to break its cryptography for being rigged or framed in Telegram's favor and said that Telegram's statements on the value of these contests as proof of the cryptography's quality are misleading. This was because the cryptography contest could not be won even with completely broken algorithms such as [[MD2 (hash function)]] used as key stream extractor, and primitives such as the [[Dual EC DRBG]] that is known to be backdoored.<ref>{{cite web| url= http://tech.eu/news/telegram-protocol-cracking-contest/| title= Cracking contest: first one who breaks Telegram gets $200,000 in bitcoins (but really, nobody wins)| first= Robin| last= Wauters| date= 19 December 2013| access-date= 2 March 2014| website= Tech.eu| archive-date= 26 December 2018| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20181226140728/https://tech.eu/news/telegram-protocol-cracking-contest/| url-status= live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news| url= http://www.cryptofails.com/post/70546720222/telegrams-cryptanalysis-contest| title= Telegram's Cryptanalysis Contest| date= 19 December 2013| access-date= 24 October 2015| newspaper= Tumblr| last= Hornby| first= Taylor| archive-date= 26 December 2018| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20181226140737/http://www.cryptofails.com/post/70546720222/telegrams-cryptanalysis-contest| url-status= live}}</ref>

=== Censorship ===
{{Further|Censorship of Telegram}}
[[File:Telegram-World.svg|Map showing the countries that are either currently blocking or have blocked Telegram in the past.{{legend|#335da3ff|Currently blocked}}{{legend|#64b4c2ff|Formerly blocked}}|thumb|271x271px]]

Telegram has been blocked temporarily or permanently by some governments including Iran, China, Brazil, and Pakistan. The Russian government blocked Telegram for several years before lifting the ban in 2020.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Erdbrink |first=Thomas |date=1 May 2018 |title=Iran, Like Russia Before It, Tries to Block Telegram App |language=en-US |work=The New York Times |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2018/05/01/world/middleeast/iran-telegram-app-russia.html |url-status=live |access-date=27 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201106232828/https://www.nytimes.com/2018/05/01/world/middleeast/iran-telegram-app-russia.html |archive-date=6 November 2020 |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=18 June 2020 |title=Russia lifts ban on private messaging app Telegram |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/telegram-russia-ban-lift-messaging-app-encryption-download-a9573181.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201107020625/https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/telegram-russia-ban-lift-messaging-app-encryption-download-a9573181.html |archive-date=7 November 2020 |access-date=27 June 2021 |website=The Independent |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Kilpatrick |first=Ryan Ho |date=13 July 2015 |title=China blocks Telegram messenger, blamed for aiding human rights lawyers |url=https://hongkongfp.com/2015/07/13/china-blocks-telegram-messenger-blamed-for-aiding-human-rights-lawyers/ |access-date=27 June 2021 |website=Hong Kong Free Press HKFP |language=en-GB}}</ref> The company's founder has said he wants the app to have an anti-censorship tool for Iran and China similar to the app's role in fighting censorship in Russia.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Telegram founder says anti-censorship tech that defeated Russian authorities should be used against Iran and China |url=https://meduza.io/en/news/2020/06/22/telegram-founder-says-anti-censorship-tech-used-to-defeat-russian-authorities-should-be-used-in-iran-and-china |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210613170350/https://meduza.io/en/news/2020/06/22/telegram-founder-says-anti-censorship-tech-used-to-defeat-russian-authorities-should-be-used-in-iran-and-china |archive-date=13 June 2021 |access-date=27 June 2021 |website=Meduza |language=en}}</ref> On 19 April 2024, Apple removed Telegram from the App Store in China.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lomas |first1=Natasha |title=Apple pulls WhatsApp, Threads from China App Store following state order |url=https://techcrunch.com/2024/04/19/threads-whatsapp-removed-from-china-app-store/ |website=TechCrunch |access-date=19 April 2024 |date=19 April 2024}}</ref>

In September 2024, Ukraine banned the usage of Telegram by government officials, military personnel, and key workers on official devices, citing fears of Russian espionage. The [[National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine]] enforced the restrictions following evidence reported to them by [[Kyrylo Budanov]], showing Russia's ability to access messages and user data on the platform. Andriy Kovalenko, head of the security council's centre on countering disinformation, clarified that the ban was limited to official devices and did not extend to personal phones.<ref>{{cite news|title=Ukraine bans official use of Telegram app over fears of Russian spying |date=20 September 2024 |url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/cybersecurity/ukraine-bans-official-use-telegram-app-over-fears-russian-spying-2024-09-20/ |access-date=22 September 2024}}</ref>

In February 2026, Russia restricted Telegram, as officials said the platform failed to protect personal data and curb criminal content.<ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/11/world/video/russia-restricts-millions-of-its-telegram-users-digvid |title=Russia restricts millions of its Telegram users |publisher=CNN |date=2026-02-12 |last=Pleitgen |first=Frederik |language=en |access-date=2026-02-12}}</ref> Durov responded that Telegram remained committed to protecting freedom of speech and user privacy, and accused Russian authorities of directing users toward a state-backed platform, presumably [[Max (app)|Max]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Telegram's Durov reaffirms commitment to privacy amid new Russian curbs |url=https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/telegrams-durov-reaffirms-commitment-privacy-amid-new-russian-curbs-2026-02-10/ |agency=Reuters |date=10 February 2026}}</ref>

==== 2019 Puerto Rico "Telegramgate" ====
{{Main|Telegramgate}}

Telegram was the main subject surrounding the 2019 Puerto Rico riots that ended up in the resignation of then-Governor [[Ricardo Rosselló]]. Hundreds of pages of a group chat between Rosselló and members of his staff were leaked. The messages were considered vulgar, racist, and homophobic, with members of the chat discussing how they would use the media to target potential political opponents.<ref>{{cite web|last=Serrano|first=Oscar J.|title=WhatsApp Gate 2.0: Nuevo chat expone a la Administración Rosselló|url=https://www.noticel.com/ahora/gobierno/whatsapp-gate-20-nuevo-chat-expone-a-la-administracion-rossello/1093250289|website=NotiCel|accessdate=19 July 2019|language=es|date=13 July 2019|archive-date=27 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190727235312/https://www.noticel.com/ahora/gobierno/whatsapp-gate-20-nuevo-chat-expone-a-la-administracion-rossello/1093250289|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==== 2021 shutdown of Russian political bots ====
In September 2021, prior to the [[2021 Russian regional elections|regional elections in Russia]], Telegram suspended several bots spreading information about the election, including a bot run by the opposition party and critics of incumbent president [[Vladimir Putin]]'s government,<ref name="RFE_TG_Censorship">{{Cite web |date=18 September 2021 |title=Telegram Messenger Blocks Navalny's Bot During Vote |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/telegram-navalny-smart-voting/31466263.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210918221938/https://www.rferl.org/a/telegram-navalny-smart-voting/31466263.html |archive-date=18 September 2021 |access-date=19 September 2021 |website=RadioFreeEurope |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |agency=AFP |date=18 September 2021 |title=Telegram Messenger Blocks Navalny Bot During Russian Election |url=https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/09/18/telegram-messenger-blocks-navalny-bot-during-russian-election-a75079 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926151950/https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/09/18/telegram-messenger-blocks-navalny-bot-during-russian-election-a75079 |archive-date=26 September 2021 |access-date=26 September 2021 |website=The Moscow Times |language=en}}</ref> citing [[election silence]] as the reason, though a blog post by the company's CEO implied the company was following Apple and Google, which "dictate the rules of the game to developers".<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 September 2021 |title=Telegram messenger blocks Russia opposition bot during vote |url=https://www.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20210918-telegram-messenger-blocks-russia-opposition-bot-during-vote |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210918153809/https://www.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20210918-telegram-messenger-blocks-russia-opposition-bot-during-vote |archive-date=18 September 2021 |access-date=18 September 2021 |website=RFI |language=en}}</ref><ref name="RFE_TG_Censorship" /> The blocking of the main Smart Voting bot was criticized by allies of [[Alexei Navalny]], a Kremlin critic and former opposition leader. Navalny's spokeswoman Kira Yarmysh called the block and the deletion of the tactical voting app from app stores "censorship [...] imposed by private companies".<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 September 2021 |title=Navalny allies accuse YouTube, Telegram of censorship in Russian election |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/navalny-allies-accuse-telegram-censorship-russian-election-2021-09-18/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210920012333/https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/navalny-allies-accuse-telegram-censorship-russian-election-2021-09-18/ |archive-date=20 September 2021 |access-date=19 September 2021 |website=Reuters |language=en}}</ref>

In a later blog post, Durov directly stated that the block was a result of pressure from Google and Apple as refusal to comply with their policies would result "in an immediate shutdown of Telegram for millions of users". The post included a screenshot showing an internal email sent by the [[App Store]] to developers, demanding the takedown of content related to Navalny.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Durov's Channel |url=https://t.me/durov/168 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926010611/https://t.me/durov/168 |archive-date=26 September 2021 |access-date=28 September 2021 |website=Telegram |language=en-US}}</ref>

==== 2022 Delhi High Court ruling ====
On 24 November 2022, Telegram disclosed the admin names, phone numbers and IP addresses of channels accused of unauthorised sharing of national exam study materials following an order by the [[Delhi High Court]] which rejected Telegram's argument that its regional servers were located in Singapore and thus no data could be disclosed as the local laws prohibit it.<ref>{{Cite court|litigants=Neetu Singh vs Telegram FZ LLC|court=High Court of Delhi at New Dehli|date=24 November 2022|url=http://164.100.60.183/writereaddata/orderSan_Pdf/pms/2022/1669618366215_31241_2022.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231204014758/http://164.100.60.183/writereaddata/orderSan_Pdf/pms/2022/1669618366215_31241_2022.pdf|url-status=bot: unknown}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Ahsan |first1=Sofi |date=29 November 2022 |title=After Delhi High Court Ruling, Telegram Discloses Names, Phone Numbers & IP Addresses Of Users Accused Of Sharing Infringing Material |url=https://www.livelaw.in/news-updates/after-court-order-telegram-discloses-phone-numbers-ip-addresses-of-users-accused-of-sharing-infringing-material-215311 |url-access=subscription |access-date=27 August 2024 |work=LiveLaw}}</ref>

====2024 arrest of Pavel Durov====
{{Main|Arrest of Pavel Durov}}

On 24 August 2024, Pavel Durov, who is both a French and UAE citizen, was arrested in France by French authorities. On 28 August he was charged with a wide array of crimes, including complicity in managing an online platform to enable illegal transactions; complicity in crimes such as enabling the distribution of [[child sexual abuse]] material; drug trafficking and fraud; and refusal to cooperate with law enforcement authorities. Durov posted bail of five million Euros, was barred from leaving France, and was released on condition he report to a French police station twice weekly. The case would be handled by a special magistrate with investigative and prosecutorial powers.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Dalton |first1=Matthew |title=French Authorities Charge Telegram Founder Pavel Durov |url=https://www.wsj.com/tech/telegram-ceo-pavel-durov-charged-french-authorities-43a125a2?mod=hp_lead_pos8 |access-date=28 August 2024 |agency=The Wall Street Journal |publisher=Dow Jones and Company}}</ref>

==== 2026 India ban ====
{{Main|2026 NEET controversy}}
In June 2026, the [[Government of India]] temporarily blocked access to Telegram ahead of a re-conducted [[National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences|National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test]] (NEET) examination, citing concerns that the platform had been used to distribute leaked examination papers.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Deep |first=Aroon |date=2026-06-16 |title=Telegram banned in India till NEET-UG re-exam |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/neet-ug-re-exam-telegram-app-restricted-in-india-at-nta-request/article71107894.ece |access-date=2026-06-17 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Telegram In Delhi High Court Over Centre's 'Temporary Ban' For NEET Re-Test |url=https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/telegram-in-delhi-high-court-over-centres-temporary-ban-for-neet-re-test-11647730 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260617084051/https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/telegram-in-delhi-high-court-over-centres-temporary-ban-for-neet-re-test-11647730 |archive-date=2026-06-17 |access-date=2026-06-17 |work=www.ndtv.com |language=en}}</ref> Telegram challenged the restriction before the [[Delhi High Court]], arguing that the ban would affect millions of legitimate users while doing little to prevent examination fraud. Telegram CEO [[Pavel Durov]] criticized the decision, saying that the company had removed hundreds of channels associated with leaked examination materials and scams in India. At the time of the restriction, Telegram reported having more than 150 million active users in India.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/india/telegram-founder-durov-says-india-has-punished-more-than-150-million-people-by-2026-06-16/|title=Telegram founder Durov says India has 'punished' more than 150 million people by banning Telegram|location=[[Moscow]]|publisher=[[Reuters]]|date=June 16, 2026|access-date=June 19, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-06-17 |title=NEET: Telegram challenges India ban over exam paper leak fears |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gy40q8wz0o |access-date=2026-06-17 |website=BBC |language=en-GB}}</ref>
